sa: पराजयं च प्राप्ताः स्मो रणे बन्धनमेव च। सभृत्यामात्यपुत्राश्च सदारबलवाहनाः॥
en: We then met with defeat and we were then all made prisoners along with our attendants, counsellors, children, wives, troops and cars.

sa: अथ काले पुनर्धीमान् गालवः प्रत्युपस्थितः। उपसंगम्य चोवाच हर्यश्वं प्रीतमानसम्॥
en: In proper time, the wise Galava again presented himself there and having approached Haryashva said to him whose desire had been satisfied.

sa: नारद उवाच एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु मृगचर्याक्रमागताम्। माधवीं प्रेक्ष्य राजानस्तेऽभिवाद्येदमब्रुवन्।॥
en: Narada said At this time, seeing Madhvi leading the life of a deer and wandering about, those kings bowing to her said

sa: न कामये भर्तृविनाकृता सुखं न कामये भर्तृविनाकृता दिवम्। न कामये भर्तृविनाकृता श्रियं न भर्तृहीना व्यवसामि जीवितुम्॥
en: I do not want happiness bereft of my husband. Without my lord I do not crave heaven itself. Deprived of my husband I do not long for prosperity. And bereft of my husband I am unable to bear life.

sa: अभिवाद्य सुपर्णस्तु गालवश्चाभिपूज्य ताम्। तया च स्वागतेनोक्तौ विष्टरे संनिषीदतुः॥
en: Suparna having done her honors, and Galava having worshipped her they were pointed to a seat by her after the usual welcome.

sa: गुरवे संश्रुतानीह शतान्यष्टौ हि वाजिनाम्। एकतः श्यामकर्णानां शुभ्राणां चन्द्रवर्चसाम्॥
en: I have promised to present to my preceptor eight hundred horses, white as the rays of moon and having one ear black.

sa: अवगाढा द्विषन्तो मे सुखो वातोऽभिवाति माम्। यस्त्वं धनमथाजैषीः कुरुभिम्रस्तमाहवे॥
en: O son! The Kuru sons had been kidnapped the kine wealth, you regain it. I feel great pleasure, wind also delighted me.

sa: संजय उवाच अजातशत्रु च वृकोदरं च धनंजय माद्रवतीसुतौ च। आमन्त्रये वासुदेवं च शौरिं युयुधान् चेकितान विराटम्॥
en: Sanjaya said I make my obeisance to him who has created no enemies, to Vrikodara, Dhananjaya and the two sons of the king of Madri and also the son of Shura, the son of Vasudeva, Yuyudhana, Chekitana and Virata,

sa: स तत्र मलदिग्धाङ्गं भरतं चीरवाससम्॥ अचतः पादुके कृत्वा ददर्शासीनमासने।
en: He there saw Bharata covered with dirt, attired in barks of trees and seated on the throne with (Rama's) shoes before him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रशम्य दाशार्हः क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणः। दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् कुरुसंसदि॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then reflecting, did the scion of the Dasharha race, speak these words to Duryodhana in that assembly of the Kurus.

sa: शक्रश्चाग्निश्च वायुश्च यमो वरुण एव च। यक्षाधिपश्च भगवांस्तथा सप्तर्षयोऽमलाः॥
en: (Then) Shakra, Agni, Vayu, Yama, Varuna, the divine lord of the Yakshas, the seven holy sages (whom Brahma created first of all).

sa: स्वयंवरे स्थिता कन्या केशिनी नाम नामतः। रूपेणाप्रतिमा राजन् विशिष्टपतिकाम्यया।॥
en: A maiden named Keshini, of peerless beauty, o king, with the desire of a good husband, resolved to to choose in Svayamvara.

sa: अवध्यो ह्यसि भूतानां कुण्डलाभ्यां समन्वितः।१२॥ अर्जुनेन विनाशं हि तव दानवसूदनः। प्रार्थयानो रणे वत्स कुण्डले ते जिहीर्षति॥
en: As you cannot surely be slain by any creature when furnished with your earrings, so the destroyer of the Danavas, O son, wishing your death at the hands of Arjuna in battle, wants to rob you of your ear-rings.

sa: योऽप्यस्या हर्षसम्भूतो मुखरागस्तदाभवत्। क्षणेन स पुनर्नष्टो निःश्वास इव दर्पणे॥
en: And the lively colour of her face sprung from her delight (at seeing Rama) as quickly disappeared as breath on a mirror.

sa: महता रथवंशेन शरजालैश्च मामकैः। अभिद्रुता भविष्यन्ति पाञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह॥
en: By means of our large number of cars and our net of arrows, the Panchalas along with the Pandavas will be vanquished.

sa: ततः सीतां पुरस्कृत्य विभीषणपुरस्कृताम्। अविध्यो नाम सुप्रज्ञो वृद्धामात्यो विनिर्ययौ॥
en: Then Avindhya, the wise and old adviser of Ravana, preceded by Sita who was herself preceded by Vibhishana, set out from Lanka.

sa: तस्यासून् पावकस्पर्शः सौमित्रिः पत्रिभिस्त्रिभिः। यथा निरहरद् वीरस्तन्मे निगदतः शृणुः॥
en: Listen, attentively as I tell you, how the heroic son of Sumitra killed (Indrajita) by means of three arrow of fiery energy.

sa: न युद्धे तात कल्याणं न धर्मार्थों कुतः सुखम्। न चापि विजयो नित्यं मा युद्धे चेत आधिथा।॥
en: My dear son, from a fight there will result no good; and how can there be virtue or worldly benefit? and how can there be happiness. Even victory is not stable; do not therefore set your mind on war.

sa: गदाभिः परिघेश्चैव राक्षसो जनिवान् कपिम्। कपिञ्च जनिवान् रक्षः सस्कन्धविटपैर्दुमैः॥
en: The Rakshasa smote the monkey with clubs and pikes and the monkey struck the Rakshasas with trees furnished with branches and trunks.

sa: कृपणाश्रुपरिक्लेदो देहन्मां शाश्वतीः समाः। तेभ्योऽहं बलवद् भीता शरणं त्वामुपागता॥
en: The tears of the sorrow-stricken survivors will burn me for good. I am very much afraid of them. I seek your protection.

sa: तेजसस्तपसश्चैव नित्यं बिभ्येद् युधिष्ठि। उभे चैते परित्याज्ये तेजश्चैव तपस्तथा॥
en: One should, O Yudhishthira, always fear these two, viz., Energy and Penances. Both these should be shirked or kept at a distance.

sa: तथेमे गर्जिता नागा: स्वयूथकुलशोभिताः। धर्मास्त्विां समासाद्य सुखं विन्दन्ति शाल्मले॥
en: Again, O Shalmali, these most beautiful elephants, bathed in sweat and indulging in cries (of joy), approach you and enjoy happiness here.

sa: एतावन्ति त्वरिष्टानि विदित्वा मानवोऽऽत्मवान्॥ निशि चाहनि चात्मानं योजयेत् परमात्मनि।
en: on Knowing all these presaging symptoms, the man of purified soul should day and night unite his soul with the Supreme Soul.

sa: इत्युक्तः प्रययौ राजन् गौतमो विगतक्लमः। फलान्यमृतकल्पानि भक्षयन् स यथेतः॥
en: Thus addressed, O king, Gautama cheerfully started from that place, eating on the way, to his best satisfaction, fruits sweet as nectar.

sa: कथैषा कथिता तत्र कश्यपेन महर्षिणा। मनःप्रह्लादिनी दिव्यां तामिहैकमनाः शृणु॥
en: What I shall recite was described there by the great Rishi Kashyapa. Listen with rapt attention to that excellent and charming throne.

sa: सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चेति गुणानेतान् प्रचक्षते। यत्ते सर्वशरीरेषु तिष्ठन्ति विचरन्ति च॥
en: Satvata, Rajas, and Tamas, are said to be the three (original) qualities. These live and act in the bodies of all creatures.

sa: आकाशोवायुरूष्मा च स्नेहो यश्चापि पार्थिवः! एष पञ्चसमाहारः शरीरमपि नैकवाटा
en: Ether, wind, heat, water and earth,-these five objects in a state of union form the body. The body is not one element.

sa: प्रतिलभ्य च सा संज्ञां शिरसा प्रणिपत्य च। उवाच भार्या भर्तारं गाधेयी भार्गवर्षभम्॥ प्रसादयन्त्यां भार्यायां मयि ब्रह्मविदां वर। प्रसादं कुरु विप्रर्षे न मे स्यात् क्षत्रियः सुतः॥
en: Regaining her senses and bowing to her lord with head (bent), the daughter of Gadhi said to her husband, that foremost one of Bhrigu's race'O twiceborn Rishi, O you who are foremost amongst those versed in Brahma, have mercy on me, your wife, who is thus appeasing you and so order that a Kshatriya son may not be born to me.

sa: ततः कालाग्निमासाद्य तदम्भो याति संक्षयम्। विनष्टेऽम्भसि राजेन्द्र जाज्वलत्यनलो महान्॥
en: He then creates the cycle-fire which dries up that Water. The Water disappearing, the great element of Fire continues to blaze dreadfully.

sa: तथेन्द्रियाणि सर्वाणि पश्यन्तीत्यभिचक्षते॥ न चेन्द्रियाणि पश्यन्ति मन एवात्र पश्यति।
en: It is commonly said that the Senses perceive. This is not true, for it is the Mind that perceives through the Senses.

sa: तामब्रवीत् ततो विप्रो राजपुत्री सुदर्शनाम्। त्वया ममार्थः कल्याणि निर्विशङ्कतदाचर॥
en: The Brahmana said to her, my business is with your body, O blessed one! Do you act accordingly without any hesitation whatever.

sa: स्त्रीभावात् पुनरश्वं तं कथमारोढुमुत्सहे। महता त्वथ यत्नेन आरुह्याश्वं नराधिपः॥
en: Seeing that extraordinary change his sons and wives and servants, and his subject of the city and the provinces were extremely amazed.

sa: अथ शून्ये पुरोधास्तु सह राज्ञा समागतः॥ कथाभिरनुकूलाभी राजानं चाभ्यरोचयत्।
en: On one occasion he met the king in a place where there was nobody present. He pleased the king by agreeable conversation.

sa: काम्यनैमित्तिका राजन् यज्ञियाः परमक्रियाः। सर्वाः सात्वतमास्थाय विधि चक्रे समाहितः॥
en: Adopting the Satvata ritual, king Uparichara, with concentrated soul, used to perform all his sacrificial acts and observances, both optional and obligatory.

sa: भीष्म उवाच विमानस्थौ तु तौ राजंल्लुब्धकः खे ददर्श ह। दृष्ट्वा तौ दम्पती राजन् व्यचिन्तयत तां गतिम्॥
en: Bhishma said lt so chanced that the fowler, O king, saw that pair while seated on their celestial car. Seeing the couple he became filled with sorrow and began to think of the means of acquiring the same end.

sa: न मातृपितृशुश्रूषा न च दैवतपूजनम्। नान्यो गुणसमाचारः पुरुषस्य सुखावहः॥
en: Dutiful services to parents, respectful adoration of deities, due practice of any good quality,-none of these can confer happiness on any one.

sa: अथ सत्याधिपत्येऽपि ज्ञानेनैवेह केवलम्। मुच्यन्ते सर्वपापेभ्यो देहे परमके स्थिताः॥
en: Not withstanding the possession of sovereignty, therefore, one becomes purged of all sins by means of knowledge alone, living in Supreme Brahma.

sa: क्षमया तिष्ठते राजन् क्षमया विनिवर्तते। संकल्पाज्जायते कामः सेव्यमानो विवर्धते॥
en: Regarding lust, it originates from resolution. Indulgence strengthens it. When a wise man resolutely turns away from it, it disappears and dies.

sa: अथैश्वर्यप्रवृत्तेषु जापकस्तत्र रज्यते। स एव निरयस्तस्य नासौ तस्मात् प्रमुच्यते॥
en: That Reciter who seeks at heart the supreme power of Yoga, has to go to hell and never becomes freed from it.

sa: अमोघा रात्रयश्चापि नित्यमायान्ति यान्ति च। यदाहमेतज्जानामि न मृत्युस्तिष्ठतीति ह।
en: When I know that Death waits for none, how can I pass my days without covering myself with the raiment of knowledge.

sa: आरणेयस्ततो दिव्यं प्राप्य जन्म महाद्युतिः॥ तत्रैवोवास मेधावी व्रतचारी समाहितः।
en: Highly effulgent and intelligent Shuka, having obtained his birth from the two sticks, continued to live there, practising many vows and fasts.

sa: तत्र गच्छस्व वै तूर्णं यदि ते हृदि संशयः। प्रवृत्तौ वा निवृत्तौ वा स ते च्छेत्स्यति संशयम्॥
en: He ordered me to come to him forthwith, if I had any doubts to be solved in the Religion of either Action or Renunciation. He gave me to understand that the king of Mithila would remove all my doubts.

sa: तवाहं पूर्वके भावे पुत्रः परपुरंजय। मायासंभावितो वीर काल: सर्वसमाहरः॥
en: O hero, I am your son. You did, in your pristine birth, beget me on Maya-I am Kala, the destroyer of all.

sa: श्रीरुवाच पुण्येषु त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वे स्थावरजङ्गमाः। ममात्मभावमिच्छन्तो यतन्ते परमात्मना॥
en: 'In the three worlds full auspiciousness, all creatures, mobile and immobile, try with their whole hearts to gain a companionship with me.

sa: न चापि शूद्रः पततीति निश्चयो न चापि संस्कारमिहार्हतीति वा। श्रुतिप्रवृत्तं न च धर्ममाप्नुते न चास्य धर्मे प्रतिषेधनं कृतम्॥
en: The Shudra never falls down; nor is he worthy of any of the rites of regeneration. The course of duties originating from the Vedas is not his. He is not interdicted, however, from practising the thirteen duties which are common to all the castes.

sa: प्रसार्येह यथाङ्गानि कूर्मः संहरते पुनः। तथेन्द्रियाणि मनसा संयन्तव्यानि भिक्षुणा॥
en: One following the duties of the mendicant order should restrain his senses and the mind like a tortoise withdrawing its outstretched limbs.

sa: प्रेयाण्यपि च सर्वाणि जह्याद् ध्यानेन योगवित्। पञ्चवर्गप्रमाथीनि नेच्छेच्चैतानि वीर्यवान्॥
en: He has no perception also of scents through the organ of smell. He would, immersed in Yoga and meditation, renounce all things.

sa: उत्सूर्यशायिनश्चासन् सर्वे चासन् प्रगेनिशाः। अवर्तन् कलहाश्चात्र दिवारानं गृहे गृहे॥
en: They used to sleep even after sunrise. They slept in the mornings Day and night, disputes and quarrels raged in every house.

sa: पाषाण इव मेघोत्थैर्यथा बिन्दुभिराहतः। नालं चालयितुं शक्यस्तथा युक्तस्य लक्षणम्॥
en: He is like a rock which is incapable of being moved in the last by even a heavy downpour from the clouds.

sa: कस्यचिद् ब्राह्मणस्यासीद् दुःखलब्धः सुतो मृतः। बाल एव विशालाक्षो बालग्रहनिपीडितः॥
en: Once upon a time a Brahmana had, after great difficulties, got a son of large eyes. The child died of infantile convulsions.

sa: कदाचिद् दिवसान् पञ्च समुत्पत्य विहङ्गमाः। षष्ठेऽहनि समाजग्मुर्न चाकम्पत जाजलिः॥
en: Sometime after, leaving their nest for five days at a time, they returned on the sixth day. Jajali still did not move.

sa: नाभिवादयते ज्येष्ठं देवरातं नराधिप। पुत्राः पञ्चाशदेवापि शप्ताः श्वपचतां गताः॥
en: For not having honoured their eldest brother Devarat, the other fifty brothers of his were imprecated, and all of them became Chandalas.

sa: कर्मन्यासकृतानां च विरक्तानां ततस्ततः। या गतिर्ब्रह्मसदने सा गतिस्त्वं सनातन॥
en: O Eternal One, you are the End of those who are unattached to all things and who have given up ail acts.

sa: चक्षुरालोचनायैव संशयं कुरुते मनः। बुद्धिरध्यवसानाय क्षेत्रज्ञः : साक्षिवत् स्थितः॥
en: The senses are for perceiving; the mind creates uncertainty. The understanding brings all knowledge to certainty. The Soul exists as a witness.

sa: बयः प्रतिविधातव्याः प्रज्ञा राज्ञा ततस्ततः! नैकशाखेन धर्मेण यत्रैषा सम्प्रवर्तते॥
en: Kings should collect wisdom from various sources. One cannot go successfully through the worldly course with the help of a one-sided morality.

sa: अवर्षति च पर्जन्ये सर्वभूतानि भूतकृत्। वसिष्ठो जीवयामास प्रजापतिरिव प्रजाः॥
en: Once when the clouds ceased to pour, Vashishtha, resembling Brahman himself, kept alive all creatures like Prajapati (by his power and kindness).

sa: ततोऽहं तप आस्थाय तोषयामास शङ्करम्। एकं वर्षसहस्रं तु वामाङ्गुष्ठाग्रविष्ठितः॥
en: I, then, began the practice of the austerest penances for pleasing Shankara. For one thousand years I stood on my left toe.

sa: वने वनचरः कश्चिज्जाजलि म वै द्विजः। सागरोद्देशमागम्य तपस्तेपे महातपाः॥
en: Practising austere penances, he proceeded at a certain time towards the sea-shore, and arrived there began to practise the most austere penances.

sa: अलं निर्बन्धमागत्य शोकस्य परिधारणे। अप्रत्ययं कुतो ह्यस्य पुनरोह जीवितम्॥
en: Stop this ardour in putting on the trappings of woe. It is impossible that this child would be restored to life again.

sa: ततः प्रणम्य शिरसा इदं वचनमब्रुवम्। यदि प्रीतो महादेवो भक्त्या परमया प्रभुः॥ नित्यकालं तवेशान भक्तिर्भवतु मे स्थिरा। एवमस्त्विति भगवांस्तत्रोक्त्वान्तरधीयत॥
en: Bowing him I said these words I the powerful Mahadeva has been pleased with me, then let devotion to him be unchanged, O Ishana! This is the boon that I solicit. The great god said mc Be it so! and disappeared there and then.

sa: यथा क्षेत्रं मृदूभूतमद्भिराप्लावितं तथा। जनयत्यङ्कुरं कर्म नृणां तद्वत् पुनर्भवम्॥
en: As a soil, saturated with water and softened thereby, causes the seed to sprout forth, similarly, the acts of men cause rebirth.

sa: उभावेतौ समफलौ समदोषौ च भारत। अज्ञानं चातिलोभश्चाप्येकं जानीहि पार्थिव॥
en: These two, viz., ignorance and covetousness, know, O king, are the same. Both produce the same fruits and same faults, O Bharata.

sa: शस्त्रविक्रयिकाश्चैव कर्तारश्च युधिष्ठिर। शल्यानां धनुषां चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who sell weapons, they who forge weapons, they who make arrows, and they who make bows, have to sink in hell.

sa: योऽयमिच्छेद् यथाकामं कामानां तदवाप्नुयात्। यदि स्यान्न पराधीनं पुरुषस्य क्रियाफलम्॥
en: If the fruits of men's deeds were not dependent on other circumstances, then one would acquire whatever object he would long for.

sa: कथमेष महाप्राज्ञ ज्वरः प्रादुर्बभौ कुतः। ज्वरोत्पत्तिं निपुणतः श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं प्रभो॥
en: How did this Fever, O you of great wisdom, originale, O lord, I wish to hear fully of the origin of Fever,

sa: रूपं चक्षुर्विपाकश्च त्रिधा ज्योतिर्विधीयते। रसोऽथ रसनं स्नेहो गुणास्त्वेते त्रयोऽम्भसः॥
en: From eyes and the digestive fire within the stomach, originate from light. Taste, tongue, and all the humours,—these three originate from water.

sa: स्तवमेतं प्रयलेन सदा रुद्रस्य संनिधौ। अब्दमेकं चरेद्भक्तः प्राप्नुयादीप्सितं फलम्॥
en: That worshipper who recites this hymn daily for one year with singleness of devotion succeeds in acquiring the end that he desires.

sa: निवृत्तरोषे तस्मिस्तु भगवत्यपराजिते। सा कन्याथ जगामास्य समीपादिति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard that when that unconquered and illustrious lord controlled his anger, the lady (called Death) went away from his side.

sa: सहस्रिणोऽपि जीवन्ति जीवन्ति शतिनस्तथा। शाकेन चान्ये जीवन्ति पश्यास्मानपि जीवतः॥
en: The masters of thousands live. The master of hundreds also live. They who overwhelmed with sorrow live. See, we too are living.

sa: कृतस्यस्यैव सम्मानः पञ्चालन् रक्षता मया। अभिभूतास्तु कालेन नैषामद्यास्ति जीवितम्॥
en: By protecting the Panchalas I have honored him. They have, however, been assailed by Time. The lease of their lives is over.'

sa: प्रेक्षन्तः सर्वतस्तौ हि योधा योधमहाद्विपौ। तावकाश्चापरे चैव साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन्॥
en: The warriors of both armies, looking at those two foremost of heroes from every side, lauded them both, saying-well done! well done.

sa: तस्मिन् प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे राजन् वीरवरक्षये॥ अनिलेनेरितं घोरमुक्तस्थौ पार्थिवं रजः।
en: During the progress, O king, of that battle in which great heroes were killed a terrible dust was raised by the wind.

sa: तत्र चागत्य चाण्डालो शरण्ये कृतकेतनः प्रयोजयति चोन्माथं नित्यमस्तंगते रवौ॥
en: Sometime after, a Chandala came to that forest and built a hut for himself. Every evening after sunset he spread his traps.

sa: नकुलाय वराहय कर्शिताय महावने। ददौ प्रीतो महाराज धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: King Yudhishthira gladly gave it to Nakula who deserved it best and who had been reduced with sufferings in the great forest.

sa: ततो मुहुर्मुहुः प्रीत्या प्रेक्षमाण: सरस्वतीम्। हयैर्युक्तं रथं शुभ्रमातिष्ठत परंतपः॥
en: Repeatedly looking with joy at the Sarasvati, that destroyer of foes then ascended an excellent car to which were yoked beautiful horses.

sa: प्राहुर्नारायणं देवं यं विश्वस्य परायणम्॥ अणीयसामणीयांसं स्थविष्ठं च स्थवीयसाम्।
en: You are the subtilest of the subtile, grossest of the gross, the heaviest of the heavy, and the highest of the high.

sa: सर्वत्र प्रार्थ्यमानेन दुर्बलेन महाबलैः। एकेनैवासहायेन शक्यं स्थातुं भवेत् कथम्॥
en: How can king, weak and alone, hold his own, when attacked on all sides by many powerful kings joined in a body?

sa: नारद उवाच आविष्कृतबलं कर्णं श्रुत्वा राजा स मागधः। आह्वयद् द्वैरथेनाजी जरासंधो महीपतिः॥ तयोः समभवद् युद्धं दिव्यास्त्रविदुषोईयोः। युधि नानाप्रहरणैरन्योन्यमभिवर्षतोः॥
en: Narada said Hearing of Karna's power the king of the Magadhas, Jarasandha, challenged him to a single combat. Both of them were masters of celestial weapons. A dreadful battle took place between them in which they struck each other with various kinds of weapons.

sa: ततः कदाचिद् राजानः समाजग्मुः स्वयंवरे। कलिङ्गविषये राजन् राज्ञश्चित्राङ्गदस्य च॥
en: Once on a time, O monarch, many kings went to a Svayamvara at the capital of Chitrangada, the king of the Kalingas.

sa: ततश्च शूलानि परश्वधानि चक्राणि नाराचशतानि चैव॥ स्ततो ह्यहन्यन्त समन्ततोऽपि।
en: From that celestial weapons came forth hundreds of long darts, battle-axes and cloth yard shafts of fearful shape and killed many warriors.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु मां दृष्ट्वा हसन् सात्यकिमब्रवीत्। किमनेन गृहीतेन नानेनार्थोऽस्ति जीवता॥
en: Seeing me, Dhrishtadyumna, laughingly addressed Satyaki, saying-What is the use of seizing the man. We will gain nothing by keeping him alive.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नवचः श्रुत्वा शिनेर्नप्ता महारथः। उद्यम्य निशितं खड्गं हन्तुं मामुद्यतस्तदा॥
en: Hearing these words of Dhrishtadyumna, the grandson of Shini, that great car-warrior, raising up his sharp sword, was ready to kill me.

sa: सूक्ष्मयोनीनि भूतानि तर्कगम्यानि कानिचित्। पक्ष्मणोऽपि निपातेन येषां स्यात् स्कन्धपर्ययः॥
en: There are many creatures that are so ininute that their existence is not perceptible. The falling of the eyelids even kills them.

sa: अवध्यः सर्वभूतानामन्तरात्मा न संशयः। अवध्ये चात्मनि कथं वध्योभवति कस्यचित्॥
en: The soul of every creature cannot be killed. When the soul cannot be killed how then can one be killed by another?

sa: राज्ञस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा कृपः शारद्वतस्तथा। द्रौणि राज्ञो नियोगेन सैनापत्येऽभ्यषेचयत्॥
en: Hearing these words of the king Kripa, the son of Sharadvat, installed Drona's son as generalissimo, at the mandate of the king.

sa: ये त्वत्र निहता राजन्नन्तरायोधनं प्रति। यथाकथंचित् पुरुषास्ते गतास्तूत्तरान् कुरून्॥
en: The remaining warriors, that have anyhow been killed on the field of battle, have attained to the region of the Uttara Kuru.'

sa: चोदयाश्वानसम्भ्रान्तः प्रविशैतद् बलार्णवम्। अन्तमद्य गमिष्यामि शत्रूणां निशितैः शरैः॥ तान् समीपगतान् दृष्ट्वा जवेनोद्यतकार्मुकान्। उवाच देवकीपुत्रं कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Beholding those Kuru heroes approach the Pandava army with uplifted bows, Kunti's son, Dhananjaya, said to the son of Devaki-"Drive the horse fearlessly and enter this deep of troops. With my keen arrows I shall to-day terminate these hostilities.

sa: क्व चिच्चोरैः क्व चिच्छस्त्रैः क्व चिद् राजभिरातुरैः। परस्परभयाच्चैव शून्यभूयिष्ठनिर्जना॥
en: Some assailed by robbers, some, by weapons and some, by bad kings, and in fear of one another, began to fly away.

sa: श्रिया विहीनैरधनैस्त्यक्तमित्रैरकिंचनैः। सौखिकैः सम्भृतानर्थान् यः संत्यजति किं नु तत्॥
en: But he who imitates those men by leaving off palatial edifices and beds and vehicles and dresses and ornaments, acts improperly, indeed.

sa: यौधिष्ठिरस्य सैन्यस्य श्रुत्वा शब्दं महारथाः। कृतवर्मा कृपो द्रौणी राजानमिदमब्रुवन्॥ इमे ह्यायान्ति संहृष्टाः पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः। अपयास्यामहे तावदनुजानातु नो भवान्॥
en: Hearing the noise made by the army of Yudhishthira, those great car-warriors, viz., Kritavarman, Kripa and the son of Drona, said to the Kuru king:-"Elated with joy and desiring for victory the Pandavas are coining here, you know. We will, therefore, leave this place."

sa: असौ दुर्योधनः पार्थ वाजिमध्ये व्यवस्थितः। छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन प्रेक्षमाणो मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: There, O Partha, Duryodhana is in the midst of his cavalry, with the umbrella held over his head and looking all around.

sa: अभिषिक्ते ततस्तस्मिन् सिंहनादो महानभूत्। तव सैन्येऽभ्यवाद्यन्त वादित्राणि च भारत॥
en: After Shalya has been appointed the commander, leonine shouts arose among your soldiers and various musical instruments also, O Bharata, were struck.

sa: अहं च त्वाभिजानामि यस्त्वं पुरुषसत्तम। त्रिदशेष्वपि विख्यातस्त्वं शक्त्या पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: I know, O best of persons, that you are celebrated for your prowess, O foremost of beings, among even the very abstracts.

sa: स्थापयेदेव मर्यादां जनचित्तप्रसादिनीम्। अल्पेऽप्यर्थे च मर्यादा लोके भवति पूजिता॥
en: Therefore, the king, should always set down rules and restraints for pleasing his subjects. People always welcome rules even regarding insignificant matters.

sa: स त्वं यज्ञैर्महाराज यजस्व बहुदक्षिणैः। यथैवेन्द्रो मनुष्येन्द्र चिराय विगतज्वरः॥
en: Do you, therefore, O monarch, celebrate sacrifices with profuse presents even as Indra did, Cking, and thereby free yourself from your fever.

sa: एनं हि पर्युपासन्ते बहुधा वरयोषितः। क्रीडन्तमिव गन्धर्वं देवकन्याः सहस्रशः॥
en: Formerly a body of the most beautiful ladies used to wait upon him, like thousands of celestial girls upon a sporting Gandharva.

sa: वृत्तानि रथयुद्धानि विचित्राणि पदे पदे॥ इदमेकं गदायुद्धं भवत्वद्याद्भुतं महत्।
en: Many wonderful single combats have taken place on cars. Let this one great and wonderful encounter with the mace take place today.

sa: नूनमेषा पुरा बाला जीवमाने महीभुजे। भुजावाश्रित्य रमते सुभुजस्य मनस्विनी॥
en: While her mighty-armed husband was formerly alive, this highly intelligent damsel used to sport within the embrace of her lords' beautiful arms.

sa: तथैव कृतवर्माणं शैनेयः शत्रुतापनः॥ योधयशुशुभे राजन् बलिं शक्र इवाहवे।
en: Similarly Kritavarman, O king, fighting with the grandson of Shini, that scorcher of foes, shone like Shakra fighting with the Asura Vala.

sa: वर्तमानः स्वशास्त्रेण संयतात्मा जितेन्द्रियः॥ अभ्युद्धरति चात्मानं प्रसादयति च प्रजाः।
en: By following his duties, à person of subdued self and having his senses under control, succeeds in raising himself and cheering others.

sa: तेषामापततां घोरस्तुमुलः समपद्यत॥ क्षुब्धस्य हि समुद्रस्य प्रावृट्काले यथा स्वनः।
en: The noise made by them when they returned was exceedingly awful, like the roar of the surging deep during the rainy season.

sa: तमभ्यगच्छद् राजेन्द्रो वेपमानः कृताञ्जलिः। युधिष्ठिरस्त्विदं तत्र मधुरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ पुत्रहन्ता नृशंसोऽहं तव देवि युधिष्ठिरः। शापार्हः पृथिवीनाशे हेतुभूतः शपस्व माम्॥
en: After she had said these words, king Yudhishthira, trembling and with joined hands, approached her and said, 'Here is Yudhishthira, O goddess, that cruel destroyer of your sons! I deserve your curses, for I am the root of this universal destruction! Oh curse me!

sa: अकिञ्चनाश्च दृश्यन्ते पुरुषाश्चिरजीविनः। समृद्धे च कुले जाता विनश्यन्ति पतङ्गवत्॥
en: One born in a mean family may live very long while one descended from a noble family dies soon like an insect.

sa: अनुरूपाणि कर्माणि भृत्येभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति। स भृत्यगुणसम्पन्नो राजा फलमुपाश्नुते॥
en: That king, who appoints servants to offices for which each is competent, succeeds, for such merit, to enjoy the happiness of sovereignty.

sa: मृतान् महानुभावांस्त्वं श्रुत्वैव पृथिवीपतीन्॥ शममानय संतापं शृणु विस्तरशश्च मे।
en: Listening to the story of those high souled kings, lessen your sorrow. Hear me as I recite fully their stories to you.

sa: ते मुहूर्ताद् रणे वीरा हस्ताहस्ति विशाम्पते॥ निहताः प्रत्यदृश्यन्त मद्रराजपदानुगाः।
en: Fighting hand to hand, O king, for a short time, those heroic warriors, viz., the followers of the Madra king, were killed.

sa: तथैव कौरवो राजा धर्मपुत्रो महामनाः। कृपप्रभृतयश्चैव किमकुर्वत ते त्रयः॥
en: What also did the Kuru king, the great son of Dharma, do? And what did those three, viz., Kripa and others do?

sa: एवं तान् वादिनः शूरान् द्रौपदेया महारथाः॥ अभ्यघ्नन् युयुधानश्च मद्रराजपदानुगान्। चक्रैर्विमथितैः केचित् केचिच्छिन्नैर्महाध्वजैः॥ ते दृश्यन्तेऽपि समरे तावका निहताः परैः।
en: Thereat those great car-warriors, viz., the sons of Draupadi, began to kill the followers of the Madra king who were uttering those words i and fighting vigorously. In that battle, some, amongst your troops, where crushed by carwheels and some slain by huge standards.

sa: तेभ्यः सर्वेभ्य एवाहुर्भयं राजोपजीविनाम्। तथैषां राजतो राजन् मुहूर्तादेव भीर्भवेत्॥
en: Those who serve kings have to fear all of them. Every moment, again, they entertain fear from the king himself, O monarch.

sa: ते सेने भृशसंतप्ते वध्यमाने परस्परम्॥ व्याकुले समपद्येतां वर्षासु सरिताविव।
en: While the two armies, in their excitement, were thus killing each other, they became much agitated like two streams in the rains.

sa: दानेनान्यं बलेनान्यमन्यं सूनृतया गिरा। सर्वतः प्रतिगृह्णीयाद् राज्यं प्राप्येह धार्मिकः॥
en: A virtuous king, having obtained a kingdom, should try to subdue some by presents, some by force, and some by sweet words.

sa: नष्टायां प्रतिपत्तौ च मोहवश्या नरास्तदा। लोभस्य वशमापन्नाः सर्वे भरतसत्तम॥
en: When their perceptions were clouded and when men became subject to error all of them became covetous, O chief of the Bharatas.

sa: तपो मन्त्रबलं नित्यं ब्राह्मणेषु प्रतिष्ठितम्। अस्त्रबाहुबलं नित्यं क्षत्रियेषु प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: The power of penances and Mantras was given to the Brahmanas; the strength of arms and of weapons was conferred upon Kshatriyas.

sa: भ्रमराणामिव वाताः शलभानामिव व्रजाः। हादिन्य इव मेघेभ्यः शल्यस्य न्यपतशराः॥
en: The arrows of Shalya, as swarms of becs or fights of locusts, were seen to fall, like thunder bolts from the clouds.

sa: यद्यस्ति बाहुवीर्यं ते तद् दर्शयितुमर्हसि। किं ब्राह्मणबलेन त्वमतिमात्र प्रवर्तसे॥
en: In truth, if you have might of arms you should display it. Why do you act so proudly helped by Brahmana power.

sa: संशप्तकावशिष्टेन बलेन महात वृतः। सुशार्मापि ययौ राजन् वीक्षमाणो भयार्दितः॥
en: Encircled by the remaining portion of the Samsaptakas which was still a large army, Susarma, looking at the terror-stricken' soldiers, went away.

sa: अभ्यद्रवन्त देवास्तान् विविधायुधपाणयः। दृष्ट्वा च स ततः क्रुद्धः स्कन्दस्तेजोबलान्वितः॥
en: Arined with various weapons, the gods pursued them. Seeing the enemy flying away, the energetic and powerful Skanda, became swollen with anger.

sa: एवं राजंस्तवाचक्षे स्वयं पन्थानमुत्तमम्। न युद्धादधिकं किंचित् क्षत्रियस्येह विद्यते॥
en: I tell you, O king, that for a Kshatriya in this world there is not a better way to heaven then battle.

sa: उत्पाद्य च बहून् पुत्रान् कुलसंतानकारिणः। कालेन महता राजन् कालधर्ममुपेयिवान्॥
en: Having begotten many sons all of whom by their children multiplied the race, he breathed his last, o king, after many years.

sa: मद्रराजस्तु सुभृशं विद्धस्तेन महात्मना। सात्यकिं प्रतिविव्याध चित्रपुङः शितैः शरै॥
en: Deeply struck by that great warrior, the king of the Madras struck Satyaki in return with sharp arrows adorned with beautiful feathers.

sa: यथा वायुस्तृणाग्राणि संवर्तयति सर्वशः। तथा कालवशं यान्ति भूतानि भरतर्षभ॥
en: As the wind tears off all the blades of grass, even so, O foremost of Bharata's race, Death rules over all creatures.

sa: अयुध्यमानो म्रियते युध्यमानश्च जीवति। कालं प्राप्य महाराज न कश्चिदतिवर्तते॥
en: He, who never fights has been seen to die, while he who engaged himself in battle has been seen to escape alive.

sa: ऐश्वर्यधनरत्नानां प्रत्यमित्रे निवर्तताम्॥ दृष्ट्वा हि पुनरावृत्ति वतामिति नः श्रुतम्।
en: If a person lives he can recover all the wealth that he may have to give to enemies for protecting his life.

sa: द्रौपदेयाश्च शत्रुघ्नं शूरमार्तायनिं शरैः॥ अभ्यवर्षन् महाराज मेघा इव महीधरम्।
en: The five sons of Draupadi poured upon that heroic and impetuous Artayani, showers of arrows like clouds pouring rain upon a mountain.

sa: का न तासां वरस्त्रीणामवस्थाद्य भविष्यति। विहीनानां तु तनयैः पतिभिर्धातृभिस्तथा॥
en: Oh, what will be the condition of those foremost of ladies who have been deprived of sons, of husbands, and of brothers.

sa: एवं द्वन्द्वशतान्यासंस्त्वदीयानां परैः सह। घोररूपाणि चित्राणि तत्र तत्र विशाम्पते॥
en: Thus hundreds of dreadful encounters, O king, took place between your ariny and the enemy, on the various parts of the field.

sa: अर्थमूलोऽपि हिंसां च कुरुते स्वयमात्मनः। करैरशास्त्रदृष्टैर्हि मोहात् सम्पीडयन् प्रजाः॥
en: That avaricious king, who foolishly oppresses his subjects by levying taxes not sanctioned by scriptures, is said to wrong his own self.

sa: ववुर्वाताः सनिर्धाताः पांशुवर्षं पपात च। चचाल पृथिवी चापि सवृक्षापपर्वता॥
en: Fierce winds began to blow, with loud sounds, Showers of dust dropped. The Earth, with her trees and mountains, began to tremble.

sa: न ववौ पवनश्चैव नाग्निर्जज्वाल वैधितः। व्यभ्रमचापि संविग्नं दिवि नक्षत्रमण्डलम्॥
en: The wind ceased to move, and fire itself, though fed, did not burn. The stars in the sky, in fear, moved irregularly.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महादेवस्तदुपादाय कार्मुकम्। आजगामाथा तत्रैव यत्र देवाः समीजिरे॥
en: Then Mahadeva, worked up with rage, and taking up that bow proceeded to that spot where the celestials were celebrating the Sacrifice.

sa: ते प्रयाता व्यरोचन्त परानभिमुखास्त्रयः। हूयमाना यथा यज्ञे समिद्धा हव्यवाहनाः॥
en: While the three went on against the enemny, they shone like three blazing fires in sacrifice, fed with libations of clarified butter.

sa: संजय उवाच कृतवर्माणमामन्त्र्य कृपं च स महारथः। द्रौणिर्मन्युपरीतात्मा शिविरद्वारमागमत्॥
en: Sanjaya said "Inviting Kritavarman as also the great carwarrior Kripa, Drona's son, worked up with rage, approached the gate of the camp.

sa: तत: क्रुद्धस्य पार्थस्य रथमार्गे विशाम्पते॥ अगम्यरूपा पृथिवी मांसशोणितकर्दमा। भीरूणां त्रासजननी शूराणां हर्षवर्धिनी॥ बभूव भरतश्रेष्ठ रुद्रस्याक्रीडनं यथा।
en: Along the track of the angry Partha's car, the ground, covered with muddy blood, became impassable, O chief of the Bharatas, like the sporting ground of Rudra. The spectacle filled the coward with fear and the brave with joy.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनो महाराज शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः॥ अवाकिरत्तां पृतनां मघो वृष्ट्येव पर्वतम्।
en: Then Arjuna, O king, covered his enemies with showers of straight arrows like a cloud pouring torrents of rain on a mountain.

sa: चत्वरेष्वथ तीर्थेषु सभास्वावसथेषु च। यथार्थवर्णं प्रणिधिं कुर्यात् सर्वस्य पार्थिवः॥
en: In places of public resort, in Tirthas, in assemblies and in the houses of the citizens, the king should keep capable spies.

sa: भग्नसक्तो महाराज शेते पांसुषु रूषितः। धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज शिखण्डी चापराजितः॥
en: With the thighs broken he is lying prostrate on earth bathed in blood. Dhristadyumna and the invincible Shikhandi have also been slain.

sa: तेषां लोकेष्वपश्यच्च जैगीषव्यं स देवलः। द्वादशाहैश्च सत्रैश्च यजन्ते विविधैर्नृप॥
en: Jaigishavya was then seen in the regions of those that perform the sacrifice called Dadashaha and various others of a similar nature.

sa: ऋषी ऊचतुः नानाशस्त्रविदः पूर्वे येऽप्यतीता महारथाः। नैतदस्त्रं मनुष्येषु तैः प्रयुक्तं कथंचन। किमिदं साहसं वीरौ कृतवन्तौ महात्ययम्॥
en: The two Rishis said Those great car-warriors who have died in this battle were masters of diverse kinds weapons. They, however, never shot such a weapon upon men. What rash act is this, O heroes, that you have done.

sa: द्विधा चिच्छेद समरे कृतहस्तः प्रतापवान्। नकुलप्रेषितां शक्तिं हेमदण्डां भयावहाम्॥
en: He then resisted with arrows the terrible gold-handled dart, that Nakula shot at hiin and the mace also that Sahadeva had hurled.

sa: सरीसृपेभ्य: स्तेनेभ्यो न चान्योन्यात् कदाचन। भयमुत्पद्यते तत्र तस्य राज्ञोऽभिरक्षणात्॥
en: On account of the protection afforded by that king, nobody entertained any fear from reptiles and thieves of from any other source.

sa: ततस्तदा कुरुश्रेष्ठ वनस्थे त्वयि भारत। अवसद् द्वारकामेत्य वृष्णिभिः परमार्चितः॥
en: Then, O Kuru chief, while you were living in the forest, he came to Dwaraka and lived there, adored of the Vrishnis.

sa: ततः शरं समादाय यमदण्डोपमं तदा॥ सुशर्माणं समुद्दिश्य चिक्षेपाशु हसन्निव।
en: Fixing then a strong arrow that resembled the rod of Yama, Partha, smiling, quickly shot it at Susharman, aiming it at him.

sa: भीमः प्रियस्ते सर्वेभ्यो भ्रातृभ्यो भरतर्षभ। तं कृच्छ्रगतमद्य त्वं कस्मान्नाभ्युपपद्यसे॥
en: O Bharata chief, of all your brothers, Bhima is dearest. Seeing him in a great danger, why do you not stir yourself.

sa: ततः शङ्खप्रणादश्च तूर्याणां च सहस्रशः। सिंहनादश्च संजज्ञे शूराणां हर्षवर्धनः॥
en: At that time there arose the sound of thousands of conchs and trumpets and loud leonine roars increasing the joy of horses.

sa: अथाब्रवीदृषिवरो देवान् वै नारदस्तथा॥ जैगीषव्ये तपो नास्ति विस्मापयति योऽसितम्।
en: Then that best of ascetics, viz., Narada, said to the gods-"There is no penance in Jaigishavya since he filled Asita with wonder!'

sa: सच क्रोधसमाविष्टः पाणौ पाणिं निपीड्य च॥ बाष्पविह्वलया वाचा राजानमिदमब्रवीत्। पिता मे निहतः क्षुद्रैः सुनृशंसेन कर्मणा॥ न तथा तेन तप्यामि यथा राजंस्त्वयाऽद्य वै। शृणु चेदं वचो मह्यं सत्येन वदतः प्रभो॥ इष्टापूर्तेन दानेन धर्मेण सुकृतेन च।
en: Beside himself with anger he squeezed his hands, and addressing the king in a voice choked with tears, he said-'My father was killed by those wretches with a cruel contrivance. That act, however, do not pain me so keenly as this condition to which you have been reduced, O king, Listen to these words of mine which I swear by truth itself, O lord, and by all my acts of piety all my gifts, my religion and the religious merits I have won.

sa: तेषां क्षुधापरीतानां नष्टा वेदाऽभिधावताम्॥ सर्वेषामेव राजेन्द्र न कश्चित् प्रतिभानवान्।
en: While wandering hungrily the Rishis had forgotten the Vedas. There was indeed, not even one amongst thein that could interpret the Vedas.

sa: तस्यास्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा भगवानक्षरः प्रभुः। प्रोवाच वचनं हृष्टः श्रव्याक्षरसमीरितम्॥
en: Lomasha said: Having heard her these words, the eternal deity of six attributes, cheerfully spoke these words to her with great distinctness.

sa: ते ताता यदि मन्यध्वमुत्सवं वारणावते। सगणाः सान्वयाश्चैव विहरध्वं यथामराः॥
en: if you desire to see the festival of Varanavata, go (there) with your friends and followers and enjoy yourselves like the celestial.

sa: स प्राजर्थे परं यत्नमकरोत् सुसमाहितः। तमभ्यगच्छद् ब्रह्मर्षिर्दमनो नाम भारत॥
en: He, with a fixity of purpose, made great endeavour for obtaining issue. O Bharata, there came before him, a Brahmarishi named Damana.

sa: अहमप्यत्र वत्स्यामि गोमत्याः पुलिने शुभे। कालं परिमिताहारो यथोक्तं परिपालयन्॥
en: O blessed lady, I shall, till then, live on the banks of the Gomati, waiting for his return and living restricted diet.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा लोमशस्य महात्मनः। आकाशगङ्गां प्रयताः पाण्डवास्तेऽभ्यवादयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard the words of the illustrious Lomasha the Pandavas reverentially worshipped the river which flows from the sky.

sa: तस्याद्य गृध्राः श्येनाश्च चण्डगोमायवस्तथा। भक्षयिष्यन्ति मांसानि ये चान्ये पुरुषादकाः॥
en: The vultures, the hawks, the fierce jackals and other carnivorous animals, will today hold a feast on the flesh of that one.

sa: अत्राछिकं सुरश्रेष्ठो जपते समरुद्गणः। साध्याश्चैवाश्विनौ चैव परिधावन्ति तं तदा॥
en: Here does the lord of the celestials with the Marutas perform his daily prayers. The Siddhas and the Ashvins wait upon him.

sa: उभे सत्यानृते त्यक्त्वा शोकानन्दौ भयाभये। प्रियाप्रिये परित्यज्य प्रशान्तात्मा भविष्यति॥
en: Renouncing both truth and falsehood, grief and joy, fear and courage, the agreeable and the disagreeable, you may acquire equanimity of soul.

sa: तत्राप्याप्लुत्य मतिमान् ब्रह्मयोनिं जगाम ह॥ ससर्ज भगवान् यत्र सर्वलोकपितामहः।
en: The intelligent Balarama, having bathed there, then went to Bramhayoni where the worshipful Grandsire of all the worlds had created the world.

sa: कलिङ्गा मागधाः प्राच्या गान्धाराः कुरवस्तथा॥ त्वामासाद्य महायुद्धे निहतः पाण्डुनन्दन।
en: The Kalingas, the Magadhas, the Kauravas, the Westerners and the Gandharvas have all been killed in dreadful battles, O son of Pandu.

sa: स तु क्रोधसमाविष्टो द्रोणपुत्रो महाबलः॥ शिखण्डिनं समासाद्य द्विधाचिच्छेद सोऽसिना।
en: Worked up with anger at this, the powerful son of Drona, approached Shikhandin and cut him in two parts with his sword.

sa: शोभसे कुण्डलाभ्यां च रुचिराभ्यां महाद्युते। विशाखयोर्मध्यगतः शशीव विमले दिवि॥
en: Adorned with your beautiful ear-rings you shine like the moon in the azure sky between the Vishakha constellations, O highly effulgent creature.

sa: अन्तर्दधुः प्रभाः सर्वा दीपैस्तैरवभासिताः। तस्मिन् कोलाहले युद्धे वर्तमाने निशामुखे॥
en: Was cast into shade by the light of those blazing (lamps), when during that night, the battle was raging hot and furious.

sa: यस्मान्मां त्वं सरिच्छ्रेष्ठे वञ्चयित्वा पुनर्गता॥ शोणितं वह कल्याणि रक्षोग्रामणिसम्मतम्।
en: Since, O best of rivers, thou hast gone away and deceived me, let thy current be changed into blood liked of Rakshasas!'

sa: अन्योन्यमभितो राजन् क्रूरमायोधनं बभौ। पत्तीनां द्रवतां चैव पादशब्देन मेदिनी॥
en: And slaughtered one another. The battle, the. 0 monarch, became terrific. In consequence of the tread of foot-soldiers rushing along, the earth.

sa: य आश्रयेत् पावयेच्चापि राजन् सर्वं शरीरं तपसा तप्यमानः। एतेन वै बाल्यमभ्येति विद्वान् मृत्युं तथा स जयत्यन्तकाले॥
en: He, who attached to austerities has recourse to asceticism and thereby purifies his body, comes to the condition of a child (free from passions, etc., characteristic of the old men) and that learned man in the end conquers death.

sa: युष्मत्तेजोविवृद्ध्यर्थं मया हुद्धर्षणं कृतम्। तदानीं विदुलावाक्यैरिति तद् वित्त पुत्रकाः॥
en: Know, that for increasing your energy, I instilled that courage into your hearts by reciting the words of Vidula, O my sons.

sa: तपोबलेन महता बाहुवेगबलेन च। नित्यमेव दुराधर्षोधर्षयन् स दितेः सुतः॥
en: That son of Diti, becoming thus unrivalled by the power of his asceticism, as well as, that of arms, always harassed (Indra).

sa: सुहृज्जनवृतौ तत्र विहृत्य मधुसूदन। सायाह्ने पुनरेष्यावो रोचतां ते जनार्दना॥
en: O Janardana, O slayer of Madhu, if you like, let us sport their with out friends and then return in the evening.

sa: नाशक्यन्त महाराज योधा वारयितुं तदा। सा पाण्डुपुत्रस्य शरैदीर्यमाणा महाचमूः॥
en: They were unable to rally the combat ts, O mighty monarch. That vast army, slaughter with arrows by the son of Pandu.

sa: भीमसेन न ते शक्या प्रवेष्टुमरिवाहिनी। मामनिर्जित्य समरे शत्रुमद्य महाबल॥
en: Bhima would also worship him, addressed the latter saying-'O Bhimasena, you shall never succeed in penetrating into the host of your enemies.

sa: तमादाय गतो राजंस्त्वरमाणो महामृगः। आश्रमात् त्वरितः शीघ्रं प्लवमानो महाजवः॥
en: And, O king, that great deer endued with great speed, soon distanced itself (a great way) from the hermitage with long leaps.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। संवादं मोक्षसंयुक्तं शिष्यस्य गुरुणा सह॥
en: Bhishma said 'Regarding it is cited the old narrative of the discourse between a preceptor and disciple on the subject of liberation.

sa: अस्तं गच्छन् यथादित्यः प्रभामादाय गच्छति। तथा जीवितमादाय कर्णस्येषुर्जगाम सः॥
en: As while moving towards the setting hill the sun withdraws all its rays so (Arjuna's) arrow passed of taking Karna's vital breaths.

sa: तस्य तद् भाषितं श्रुत्वा त्वरमाणो धनंजयः। वायव्यास्त्रेण तैरस्तां शरवृष्टिमपाहरत्॥
en: Hearing those words of his (Krishna's), Dhananjaya quickly dispelled that arrowy shower poured by the enemy, by means of the Vavabha weapon.

sa: श्रोतारः श्रद्दधानाश्च येषां शुद्ध च मानसम्। तेषां व्यक्त जिता लोकाः श्रद्दधनेन साधुना॥ मुच्यते किल्बिषाच्चैच न सा पापेन लिप्यते। धर्मे च लभते नित्यं प्रेत्य लोकगतो नरः॥
en: They who listen to these scriptures, they who are gifted with faith and they who have a pure heart, it is well known conquer many regions of felicity. Those pious men who are gifted with faith, become cleansed of all since and no sin can touch them. Such men always increase in virtue and succeed in attaining to the celestial region.

sa: तस्यामुद्धार्यमाणायां संक्षोभः समजायत। एवं भवन्तो जानन्तु छिद्यतां संशयश्च वः॥
en: On account of thus raising her up, this agitation has taken place. Know this to be the cause and dispel your doubts.

sa: अभ्यतीत्य तु तत् सर्वमुवाच मधुसूदनः। युधिष्ठिरस्य कार्यार्थमिह वत्स्यामहे क्षपाम्॥
en: All this being done, the slayer of Madhu said-with view to the attainment of Yudhishthira's object must we pass the night here.

sa: सा प्रयत्नेन महता निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा। त्रिषु लोकेषु नारीणां रूपेणाप्रतिमाभवत्॥
en: She was created by Vishvakarma with good deal of care. She became matchless in beauty amongst the women of the three worlds.

sa: प्रमत्तो ग्राम्यधर्मेषु मन्दात्मा पापनिश्चयः। मम पुत्रः सुदुर्बुद्धिः पृथिवीं घातयिष्यति॥
en: Mad in performing acts of the most vulgar kind, my wicked-minded and ever sinful son of wicked policies will destroy the earth.

sa: स तैः परिवृतः श्रीमान् भ्रातृभिः कुरुसत्तमः। विबभावतिदीप्तौजा देवैरिव शतक्रतुः॥
en: Endued with blazing effulgence the handsome chief of the Kurus, surrounded by his brothers, shone like Shatakratu (Indra) surrounded by the celestials.

sa: उपसर्प्य च देवेशं ब्रह्माणं लोकसाक्षिकम्। भूत्वा प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे वाक्यमुच्चारयंस्तदा।॥
en: Coming to the deity Brahma, the witness of the acts of all beings, they with joined hands thus said to these words.

sa: तदहं प्रेक्ष्य दैत्यानां पुरमद्भुतदर्शनम्। अपृच्छं मातलिं राजन् किमिदं वर्ततेऽद्भुतम्॥
en: Beholding that city of the Daitya, wonderful to look at, O king, I asked Matali "What is it that looks so marvellous?"

sa: असंशयं केशव पाण्डवानां भवान् गतिस्त्वच्छरणा हि पार्थाः। कालोदये तच्च ततश्च भूयः कर्ता भवान् कर्म न संशयोऽस्ति।॥
en: "O Keshava, it admits of no doubt that you are the refuge of the Pandavas; and the Parthas are under your protection. When the time for action will arrive, you will undoubtedly do all that you have just said.

sa: तत्र गत्वा पुनर्नेमं लोकमायान्ति भारत। स्वयम्भुवं महात्मानं देवदेवं सनातनम्॥
en: Repairing thither and attaining to the selfexistent, high-souled and eternal god of gods. O Bharata, do not come back to this world.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण तपोधन। कथ्यमानं त्वया विप्र राज्ञां चरितमुत्तमम्॥
en: O ascetic, O Brahmana, I desire to hear all this in detail, the excellent history of that king (Bhagiratha) narrated by you.

sa: त्वत्प्रसादान्महाभागलोकैः प्राप्तं महत् सुखम्। त्वत्तेजसा च निहताः कालेयाः क्रूरविक्रमाः॥
en: “O mighty-armed one, through your favour the world has obtained great happiness. The greatly powerful Kalkeyas are all destroyed by your might.

sa: अथ सुन्दरिकातीर्थं प्राप्य सिद्धनिषेवितम्। रूपस्य भागी भवति दृष्टमेतत् पुरातनैः॥
en: Then going to the Tirtha called Sundarika, frequented by the Siddhas, it is seen in the Puranas, one obtains personal beauty. one

sa: एष रैभ्याश्रमः श्रीमान् पाण्डवेय प्रकाशते। भारद्वाजो यत्र कविर्यवक्रीतो व्यनश्यत॥
en: O son of Pandu, yonder is the beautiful hermitage of Raivya where died the son of Bharadvaja, Yavakrit, learned in the Vedas.

sa: ते सर्वे त्वरिता गत्वा ददृशुः शुभकाननाम्। पद्मसौगन्धिकवती नलिनी सुमनोरमाम्॥
en: Adorned with golden lotuses and other lilies and surrounded by beautiful woods. On its shores they saw the high-souled and energetic Bhima.

sa: सर्वे प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठाः सर्वे चामिततेजसः। सर्वे सर्वास्त्रविद्वांस देवैरपि सुदुर्जयाः॥
en: All (the Pandavas) are the foremost of smiters, all immeasurably effulgent, all skilled in every weapon, all invincible even before the celestials.

sa: अजातशत्रो त्वं चैव द्रक्ष्यसे तानि संयुगे। योज्यमानानि पार्थेन द्विषतामवमर्दने॥
en: O Ajatashatru (Yudhishthira), you will behold them when Partha will make use of them for the destruction of your enemies in battle."

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच राजपुत्रा इमे राजञ्छोभन्ते यैर्विभूषिताः। कुण्डलानि च निष्काश्च सर्वं राजविभूषणम्। एतन्मम धनं राजंस्तेन दीव्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: Yudhisthira said O_king, these princes here, who look resplendent in their ornaments and their earrings, and Nishkas and the royal ornaments on their persons are still my wealth. With this wealth, O king, I shall (now) play with you.

sa: रणे तु राक्षसगणं रावणं लोकरावणम्। निशाचरेन्द्रं हत्वा तु सभ्रातृसुतबान्धवम्॥
en: And also Ravana, that oppressor of the world, the king of the Rakshasas with all his Rakshasa relatives, brothers, sons and kindred.

sa: अयोध्यायां तु धर्मज्ञं दीर्घयज्ञं महाबलम्। अजयत् पाण्डवश्रेष्ठो नातितीव्रण कर्मणा॥
en: The best of the Pandavas (Bhima) then vanquished the greatly powerful and virtuous (king) Dirghayajna of Ayodhya by performing greatly fearful deeds.

sa: इन्द्रेण सहितं यस्य हविराचयणं स्मृतम्। अग्निराचयणो नाम भानोरेवान्वयस्तु सः॥
en: The fire to whom with Indra, the Agrayana oblation is made is called Agrayana fire. He is the (fourth) son of Bhanu.

sa: त्वमेव राजानासि श्रेयःकारणमेव च। यत्रेच्छसि महाराज निवासं तत्र कुर्महे॥
en: You know also, O king, what conduces to our well-being; and wherever you wish, O great king, we shall fix our habitation.

sa: अवश्यं चैव गन्तव्या भवता द्वारकापुरी। एवमुक्तः स धर्मात्मा युधिष्ठिरसहायवान्॥ अभिगम्याब्रवीत् प्रीतः पृथां पृथुयशा हरिः। साम्राज्यं समनुप्राप्ताः पुत्रास्तेऽद्य पितृष्वसः॥
en: But (I know) you must have to go to the city of Dwarka”. Having been thus addressed, the virtuous-minded and the world renowned Hari (Krishna), accompanied by Yudhishthira, went to Pritha and cheerfully said, “O Aunt, your sons have today obtained the imperial dignity.

sa: तत्र साध्यास्तथा विश्वे मरुतोऽथाश्चिनौ तथा। आदित्या वसवो रुद्रास्तथा ब्रह्मर्षयोऽमलाः॥ राजर्षयश्च बहवो दिलीपप्रमुखा मृपाः। तुम्बुरुर्नारदचैव गन्धर्वी च ह हाहुहूः॥
en: There he met with Sadhyas, Vishvas, the Maruts, the twin Ashvins, the Adityas, the was Vasus, the Rudras and the pure Brahmana saints. Many a royal saint, many kings headed by the king Dilipa, Tumbaru, Narada and the two Gandharvas named Haha and Huhu.

sa: अनुज्ञातस्तु गान्धारिः कर्णेन सहितस्तदा। निर्ययौ भरतश्रेष्ठो बलेन महता वृतः॥
en: Having received permission, the son of Gandhari, that foremost of the Bharata race (Duryodhana) with Karna and with a large host started.

sa: ततो जलधरश्यामो वरुणो यादसां पतिः। पश्चिमो दिशमास्थाय गिरमुच्चारयन् प्रभुः॥
en: Thereupon stationed in the western quarter, Varuna, the lord of waters and yellow as the clouds gave vent to the following words.

sa: तं च भीमं महात्मानं तस्यास्तीरे मनस्विनम्। ददृशुनिहतांश्चैव यक्षांश्च विपुलेक्षणान्॥
en: And (they saw) also the slain Yakshas of large eyes, with their bodies, eyes, arms and thighs smashed and their heads crushed.

sa: शिक्ष मे भवनं गत्वा सर्वाण्यस्त्राणि भारत। वायोरग्नेर्वसुभ्योऽपि वरुणात् समरुद्गणात्॥
en: Repairing to my abode, O Bharata, learn all the weapons of Vayu, of Agni, of the Vasus, of Varuna of the Marutas,

sa: भिन्नकायाक्षिबाहूरून् संचूर्णितशिरोधरान्। तं च भीमं महात्मानं तस्यास्तीरे व्यवस्थितम्॥ सक्रोधं स्तब्धनयनं संदष्टशनच्छदम्। उद्यम्य च गदां दो• नदीतीरेष्ववस्थितम्॥
en: On seeing the high-souled Bhima standing on the shore of that lake in angry mood and with steadfast eyes and biting lips, with his mace upraised by his two hands, like Yama with his mace at the universal dissolution.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच इत्युक्तः स प्रविश्याथ ददर्श परमार्चितम्। सौधं हृद्यं चतुःशालमतीव च मनोरमम्॥ देवतागृहसंकाशं दैवतैश्च सुपूजितम्। शयनासनसम्बाधं गन्धैश्च परमैयुतम्॥
en: Markandeya said : Having been thus addressed, he went in and saw a magnificent and charming house, divided in suits of rooms, resembling the abode of the celestials adorned by the gods. It was furnished with seats and beds and filled with excellent perfumes.

sa: दृष्टं प्रमाणं विपुलं शरीरस्यास्य ते विभो। संहरस्व महावीर्य स्वयमात्मानमात्मना॥
en: "O lord, O greatly mighty one. I have seen the vast dimensions of your body. Now decrease it with your own prowess.

sa: स्थितः। नारदश्च सभामध्ये कुरूणामग्रतः महर्षिभिः परिवृतो रौद्रं वाक्यमुवाच ह॥
en: To the Sabha (and stood) in the midst of the Kurus, Narada surrounded by great Rishis. He then uttered these terrible words.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं सम्भाषमाणास्ते सुबाहुविषयं महत्। ददृशुर्मुदिता राजन् प्रभूतगजवाजिमत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, having thus conversed, they saw with delight the extensive kingdom of Suvaka abounding in horses and elephants.

sa: प्रवेक्ष्यसीति तं शक्रः पुनरेवाभ्यभाषत। जगाम स तथेत्युक्त्वा दमयन्त्या निवेशनम्॥
en: Indra again said to him in reply "you shall get access." Nala, saying “so be it," repaired to the mansion of Damayanti.

sa: मेघजालमिवाकाशे विदार्याभ्युदितं रविम्। दृष्ट्वा मां बान्धवाः सर्वे हर्षमाहारयन् पुनः॥
en: Seeing me, all my friends rejoiced as men are rejoiced on seeing the sun rising in the sky after dispersing the clouds.

sa: ऋषयोऽपि हिधैर्येण जिता वै ते महाभुजा यत् तु दत्तवती शापमुर्वशी तव मानद॥ स चापि तेऽर्थकृत् तात साधकश्च भविष्यति॥ अज्ञातवासो वस्तव्यो भवद्भिर्भूतलेऽनघ। वर्षे त्रयोदशे वीर तत्र त्वं क्षपयिष्यसि॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, O giver of proper respects, you have defeated even the Rishis by your patience. Urvashi's curse will be to your good. O child, it will come very much to your use. O sinless one, O hero, you shall have to pass on earth the thirteenth year (of your exile) disguised and undiscovered. It will then the curse will be much to your benefit.

sa: पिनाकगोप्जे सूर्याय मङ्गल्याय च वेधसे। प्रसादये त्वां भगवन् सर्वभूतमहेश्वर॥
en: O wielder of the Pinaka, O Surya, O pure bodied deity, O exalted one, O lord of all creatures, I adore you.

sa: कर्कोटकस्य नागस्य दमयन्त्या नलस्य च। ऋतुपर्णस्य राजर्षेः कीर्तनं कलिनाशनम्॥
en: To recite the history of Naga Karkotaka, of Damayanti, of Nala and of the royal sage Rituparna, is destructive of evil (Kali).

sa: दर्भचीरं निवस्याथ दण्डाजिनविभूषितः। शीर्णं च पतितं भूमौ पर्णं समुपयुक्तवान्।॥
en: Clad in cloth made of grass and with deerskin and holding the Danda (stick), he ate withered leaves fallen on the ground.

sa: विदेहराजस्य महीपतेस्तौ विप्रावुभौ मातुलभागिनेयौ। प्रविश्य यज्ञायतनं विवादे बन्दिं निजग्राहतुरप्रमेयौ॥
en: These two Brahmanas of matchless energy went to the sacrificial ground of the king of Videha and defeated Bandi (in a controversy).

sa: स रामं विह्वलं कृत्वा तेजश्चाक्षिष्य केवलम्। आगच्छज्ज्वलितो बाणो रामबाहुप्रचोदितः॥
en: Confounding (Parshu) Rama by the effulgence of the arrow shot by the hand of Rama, it came back blazing into his hand.

sa: न किंचिदुक्त्वा दुर्मेधास्तस्थौ किंचिदवाङ्मुखः तमशुश्रूषमाणं तु विलिखन्तं वसुंधराम्॥ दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनं राजन् मैत्रेयं कोप आविशत्। स कोपवशमापनो मैत्रेयो मुनिसत्तमः॥
en: That wicked wretch (Duryodhana) did not speak a word, but he hung down his head. O king, seeing Duryodhana thus offer an insult to him by silently scratching the earth (by his foot), Maitreya became angry. That best of Rishis, Maitreya, overwhelmed with anger.

sa: सम्मोहयन्निवेमान् स त्रील्लोकान् सचराचरान्। तस्य तं निनदं श्रुत्वा महामेघौघनिः स्वनम्॥ उत्पेततुर्महानागौ चित्रश्चैरावतश्च ह। तावापतन्तौ सम्प्रेक्ष्य स बालोऽर्कसमद्युतिः॥ द्वाभ्यां गृहीत्वा पाणिभ्यां शक्ति चान्येन पाणिना अपरेणाग्निदायादस्ताम्रचूडं भुजेन सः॥ महाकायमुपश्लिष्टं कुक्कुटं बलिनां वरम्। गृहीत्वा व्यनदद् भीमं चिक्रीड च महाभुजः॥
en: That mighty one uttered such a terrible roar that the three worlds with their mobile and immobile divisions became struck with fear. Hearing that sound which seemed like the roarings of big clouds, the great Nagas, Chitra and Airavata, were shaken with fear. Seeing them unsteady, that lad shining with sun like refulgence, held them with both his hands. With a dart in one hand and with a stout, redcentral and big cock fast secured in another, that mighty-armed son of Agni sported about making a fearful noise.

sa: कोसलाधिपतिं चैव तथा वेणातटाधिपम्॥ कान्तारकांश्च समरे तथा प्राक्कोसलान् नृपान्।
en: He then defeated in battle the king of Kosala, the king of Venatatha, the Kantarakas, and the kings of the eastern Kosalas.

sa: भरतानां स्त्रियः सर्वा गान्धार्या सह संगताः॥ प्राक्रोशन् भैरवं तत्र दृष्ट्वा कृष्णां सभागताम्। धर्मिष्ठां धर्मपत्नी च रूपयौवनशालिनीम्॥
en: The ladies of the Bharata race, with Gandhari, seeing the virtuous, young and beautiful Krishna (Draupadi), the wedded wife (of the Pandavas), dragged into court wept aloud. They are even now weeping every day along with all (my) subjects.

sa: विदुर उवाच एतावता पुरुषं ये त्यजन्ति तेषां वृत्तं साक्षिवद् ब्रूहि राजन्। राज्ञां हि चित्तानि परिप्लुतानि सान्त्वं दत्त्वा मुसलैर्घातयन्ति॥
en: Vidura said O king, tell us (impartially) like a witness what you think of the conduct of those who abandon men that give them such instruction (as I give you). The hearts of kings are unsteady. Granting protection first, they strike with clubs afterwards.

sa: विनिगृह्य हरीनश्वान् रथं च मम युध्यतः। सर्वतो मामविध्यन्त सरथंधरणीधरैः॥
en: were When engaged in fighting, (they) seizing the horses and the car, covered me on the car, on all sides with rocks.

sa: लोमशः सिद्धमार्गेण जगामानुपमद्युतिः। स्वेनैव स प्रभावेण द्वितीय इव भास्करः॥
en: Lomasha of matchless effulgence proceeded in the path of the Siddhas by virtue of his own (ascetic) prowess, like a second sun.

sa: सरस्वतीं समासाद्य तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः। सारस्वतेषु लोकेषु मोदते नात्र संशयः॥
en: Going to the Sarasvati, he who offers libations to the Pitris and the celestials, no doubt sports in the regions of Sarasvati.

sa: पुण्ये गिरौ सुराष्ट्रेषु मृगपक्षिनिषेविते। उज्जयन्ते स्म तप्ताङ्गो नाकपृष्ठे महीयते॥
en: He who performs austerities on the sacred hill, Ujjyayanta in Saurashtra, abounding in birds and beasts, is adored in the celestials region.

sa: शितेन ते परशुना स्वयमेवान्तको नृप। शिरांस्यपाहरत्वाजौ रिपूणां भद्रमस्तु ते॥
en: Bandi said: O king, it is with your sharp axe that Yama severs the heads of his enemies. May prosperity attend you.

sa: पृथिवीं लागलेनेह भित्त्वा बीजं वपत्युत। आस्तेऽथ कर्षकस्तूष्णीं पर्जन्यस्तत्र कारणम्॥
en: Having tilled the ground with plough one sows the seeds; the tiller then sits silent (for) the clouds are the next cause.

sa: अथ मोदागिरौ चैव राजानं बलवत्तरम्। पाण्डवो बाहुवीर्येण निजघान महामृधे॥
en: The Pandava (Bhima) then in a fearful fight killed by the strength of his arms the mighty king who dwelt in Madagiri.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा लोकपालांस्तु समेतान् गिरिमूर्धनि। जगाम विस्मयंधीमान् कुन्ती पुत्रोधनंजयः॥
en: Beholding all the protectors of the world assembled on the summit of the mountain, the intelligent son of Kunti, Dhananjaya, was amazed.

sa: नातप्ततपसा शक्यो द्रष्टुमेष महागिरिः। आरोढुं वापि कौन्तेय तस्मानियतवाग भव॥
en: O son of Kunti, none can look at or ascend this great hill except he who has performed asceticism. Therefore be silent.

sa: मतङ्गस्य तु केदारस्तत्रैव कुरुनन्दन॥ तत्र स्नात्वा कुरुश्रेष्ठ गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्।
en: O descendant of Kuru, there is Matanga's Tirtha called Kedara, bathing there one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: विपुलैरभिजायन्ते लब्धास्तैरेव मङ्गलैः। कर्मजा हि मनुष्याणां रोगा नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥ आधिभिश्चैव बाध्यन्ते व्याधैः क्षुद्रमृगा इव। ते चापि कुशलैवैद्यैर्निपुणैः सम्भृतौषधैः॥ व्याधयो विनिवार्यन्ते मृगा व्याधैरिव द्विज। येषामस्ति च भोक्तव्यं ग्रहणीदोषपीडिताः॥
en: The diseases froin which men suffers are certainly the result of their own Karma. They then behave like small deer in the hands of the hunters. They are afflicted with mental troubles. O Brahmana, as deer are stopped by the hunters, so these diseases are checked by able and skillful physician with their many drugs. Those that have objects of enjoyments suffer from severe bowl complaints.

sa: ततः कनखले स्नात्वा त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then bathing in Kanakhala and fasting there for three nights one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and goes to the celestials region.

sa: एते च नातिधनिनोधनार्थश्च महान् मम। यथाशक्त्यविहिंस्यान्यान् संविभागं प्रयच्छ नः॥
en: These kings are not very wealthy, but my necessity of wealth is great. Give us what you can without injuring any other.

sa: ततो वाराणसीं गत्वा अर्चयित्वा वृषध्वजम्। कपिलाह्रदे नरः स्नात्वा राजसूयमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Then going to Varanasi and worshipping Vrishadhvaja (Shiva) and then bathing in the Kapalihrada a man obtains the fruits of Rajasuya sacrifice.

sa: बीजान्यादाय सर्वाणि सागरं पुप्लुवे तदा। नौकया शुभया वीर महोर्मिणमरिंदम॥
en: O chastiser of foes, O hero, procured all the different seeds and set sail in an excellent vessel on the surging sea.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टः स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः॥
en: Addressing Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, thus and being worshipped by the Maharshis, the hundred eyed (Indra) left for heaven with delight.

sa: ततश्चटचटाशब्दः सुघोरः समपद्यत। पाण्डवस्य च मुष्टीनां किरातस्य च युध्यतः॥
en: In consequence of the fight with fists between the son of Pandu (Arjuna) and the Kirata, great sounds arose in that place.

sa: दिदृक्षुरस्मि सम्प्राप्तो वन्दिनं राजसंसदि। निवेदयस्व मां द्वा:स्थ राज्ञे पुष्करमालिने।॥
en: O gate-keeper, I have come with the desire of secing Bandi. Go, inform the king (Janaka) adorned with the garlands of lotuses.

sa: ततस्ते भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा परिष्वज्य महारथाः। तत्रोपविविशुः पार्थाः प्राप्ता गतिमनुत्तमाम्॥
en: Then having seen their brother and having embraced him and having attained to excellent state, those mighty car-warriors the Parthas-sat down (there).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा पाण्डवः सत्यविक्रमः। भीष्मद्रोणौ नमस्कृत्य प्रातिष्ठत युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed the greatly powerful Pandava (Yudhisthira), saying, “Be it so" and bowing low to Bhisma and Drona, went away.

sa: ततो गयां समासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: Then going to Gaya with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and also saves his race.

sa: मा भैष्ट राक्षसान्मूढाद् गतिरस्य मया हृता। नातिदूरे महाबाहुर्भविता पवनात्मजः॥
en: "Don't be afraid of this wicked Rakshasa; I have checked his speed. The mighty-armed son of Vayu (Bhima) is not far away.

sa: त्रिषु लोकेषु कीर्तिश्च तवाक्षय्या भविष्यति। वशगाश्च भविष्यन्ति सुरास्तव महाभुज॥
en: Your fame will be everlasting all over the three worlds. O mighty armed hero, all the celestials will pay allegiance to you."

sa: गदायुद्धसमाचारं बुद्ध्यमानः स वीर्यवान्। व्यंसयामास तं तस्य प्रहारं भीमविक्रमः॥
en: And that spirited one of dreadful prowess (at last) baffled the attack (of the Rakshasa) by resorting to his skill in mace-fighting.

sa: दशकोटिसहस्राणि तीर्थानां वै महामते। सांनिध्यं पुष्करे येषां त्रिसंध्यं कुरुनन्दन॥
en: O high-ininded one, O descendant of Kuru, at the three Sandhyas, there are always present hundred thousand millions of Tirthas in Pushkara.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु तपस्विषु महात्मसु। पिनाकपाणिर्भगवान् सर्वपापहरो हरः॥ कैरातं वेषमास्थाय काञ्चनदुमसंनिभम्। विभ्राजमानो विपुलो गिरिर्मेरुरिवापरः॥
en: When all those high-souled ascetics went away, the wielder of trident, the exalted lord Hara, the destroyer of all sins. Assuming the form of a Kirata (hunter), blazing like a golden tree, appearing like a second huge Meru mountain.

sa: ततस्ते पाण्डवाः सर्वे सभार्याः सपुरोहिताः। आनर्चुः पुण्डरीकाक्षं परिवत्रुश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Then the Pandavas together with their wife and priest paid then respects to the lotus-eyed (Krishna) and surrounded him on all sides.

sa: तदाहं बृहयिष्यामि स्वरवेण रवं तव। विजयस्यध्वजस्थश्च नादान् मोक्ष्यामि दारुणान्॥
en: I shall then with my own (shouts) add to your shouts. Remaining on Vijaya's (Arjuna) flag-staff, I shall send forth fearful shouts.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच परेषामेव यशसा श्लाघसे त्वं सदा क्षत्तः कुत्सयन् धार्तराष्ट्रान्। जानीमहे विदुर यत् प्रियस्त्वं बालानिवास्मानवमन्यसे नित्यमेव॥
en: Duryodhana said O Khattwa, you are always boasting of the fame of our foes. You always depreciate the sons of Dhritarashtra. O Vidura, we know whose friend you really are. You always disregard us as if we are children.

sa: अधृष्यं वरुणस्येव निधिपूर्णमिवोदधिम्। एकाहं वेद्मि कोशं वै पतीनां धर्मचारिणाम्॥
en: While my husbands were engaged in virtuous pursuits, I supervised their treasury as inexhaustible as the ever full abode of Varuna (ocean).

sa: सोऽयं नूनमनुप्राप्तस्त्वत्कृते काल उत्तमः। त्वरितं कुरुत श्रेयो नैतदेतावता कृतम्॥
en: For your sake, that fearful time of destruction has come, Do without any loss of time what may be beneficial to you.

sa: तत्र संध्यामुपासीत ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः। तेन ह्युपास्ता भवति संध्या द्वादशवार्षिकी॥
en: The Brahmana of rigid vows who recites his Sandhya (prayers) there but once obtains the merit of reciting Sandhya for twelve years.

sa: परनेयोऽग्रणीर्यस्य स मार्गान् प्रति मुह्यति। पन्थानमनुगच्छेयुः कथं तस्य पदानुगाः॥
en: He often loses his way whose guide follows the instruction of others. How can those who follow him obtain the right path?

sa: कृष्णाजिनानि शक्तीश्च त्रिशूलान्यायुधानि च। स्थापयन् द्विजशार्दूलो देशेषु विजितेषु च॥
en: When the countries will be (all) subjugated, that foremost of Brahmanas, having cast away the deer-skins, lances and tridents and other weapons.

sa: उपविष्टाः शयानाश्च मन्ति जीवाननेकशः। ज्ञानविज्ञानवन्तश्च तत्र किं प्रतिभाति ते॥
en: Even wise and learned men kill many animals in various ways when sleeping or resting. What have you to say to this?

sa: शृण्वानस्यैव रैभ्यस्य यवक्रीत विचेष्टितम्। दहन्निव तदा चेतः क्रोधः समभवन्महान्॥
en: Having heard of this gross misbehaviour of Yavakrit, Raibhya's heart burnt as if in fire and he was filled with great anger.

sa: तेषां स सर्वं चरितं परेषां वने च वासं परमप्रतीतः। अस्त्रार्थमिन्द्रस्य गतं च पार्थं निवेशन हृष्टमनाः शशंस॥
en: Being highly pleased, he narrated to them all the machinations of his enemies and how he lived in the forest and how Arjuna had gone to the abode of Indra; all this he narrated in great gladness of heart.

sa: स भीमं सहसाभ्येत्य पृदाकुः कुपितो भृशम्। जग्राहाजगरो ग्राहो भुजयोरुभयोर्बलात्॥
en: Seeing that, Bhima got so near to him, that goat-devouring serpent suddenly seized him forcibly into the gripe of its two arms.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच द्वाविन्द्राग्नी चरतो वै सखायौ द्वौ देवर्षी नारदपर्वतौ च। द्वावश्विनौ द्वे रथस्यापि चक्रे भार्यापती द्वौ विहितौ विधात्रा॥
en: Ashtavakra said : The two friends, Agni and Indra, move together; the celestials sages are Two Narada and Parvata, the Ashvins are Two, the wheels of a car are two. It is Two, husband and wife, that live together as ordained by the deity.

sa: ततो भीष्मोऽब्रवीद् राजन् धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्। क्रियतामहणं राज्ञां यथाहमिति भारत॥
en: O king, Bhishma then thus spoke to Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, “O descendant of Bharata, now offer Arghyas to the kings as each deserves".

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मुच्यतामयमायुष्मन् भ्राता मेऽमितविक्रमः। वयमाहारमन्यं ते दास्यामः क्षुनिवारणम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said: O long-lived serpent, (kindly) liberate my exceedingly powerful brother. We will give you some other food to satisfy your hunger.

sa: त्रिशूलाङ्कानि पानि दृश्यन्ते कुरुनन्दन। महादेवस्य सांनिध्यं तत्र वै पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: And lotuses are seen with the marks of trident. O descendant of Kuru, O foremost of men, Mahadeva is always present there.

sa: क्रोधस्त्वपण्डितैः शश्वत् तेज इत्यभिनिश्चितम्। रजस्तु लोकनाशाय विहितं मानुषं प्रति॥
en: Anger is regarded by the illiterate as equivalent to energy, anger has been given to mankind for the destruction of the world.

sa: द्रौपद्या रक्षणं कार्यमित्युवाचधनंजयम्। नकुलं सहदेवं च व्यादिदेश द्विजान् प्रति॥
en: After having given instructions Dhananjaya for the protection of Draupadi and having directed Nakula and Sahadeva to take care of the Brahmanas.

sa: लोमश उवाच यवक्रीतमथोक्त्वैवं देवाः साग्निपुरोगमाः। संजीवयित्वा तान् सर्वान् पुनर्जग्मुस्त्रिविष्टपम्॥
en: Having said this to Yavakrit, the celestials with Indra at their head restored them all to life and went away to heaven.

sa: इत्यहं तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा परमदुर्मनाः। निश्चयं नाधिगच्छामि कर्तव्यस्येतरस्य च॥
en: Having heard his words, my heart became heavy and I could not ascertain what I should do and what I should not.

sa: इति तस्य निशम्याहं सारथेः करुणं वचः। अवेक्षमाणो यन्तारमपश्यं शरपीडितम्॥
en: Hearing these piteous words of my charioteer. I looked at him and saw that my charioteer had been fearfully wounded with arrows.

sa: चिन्तयामास जिष्णुस्तु भगवन्तं हुताशनम्। पुरस्तादक्षयौ दत्तौ तूणौ येनास्य खाण्डवे॥
en: Jishnu (Arjuna) then thought of the exalted Agni who had forinerly given him two inexhaustible quivers at the burning of the Khandava.

sa: एनं हि विपुलप्राणमद्य हत्वा वृकोदरम्। सम्भक्ष्य जरयिष्यामि यथागस्त्यो महासुरम्॥
en: Killing this huge bodied Vrikodara (Bhima) today. I shall eat him up and digest him as Agasta did the great Asura (Vatapi).

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच महाभयाः कितवाः संनिविष्टा मायोपधा देवितारोऽत्र सन्ति। धात्रा तु दिष्टस्य वशे किलेदं सर्वं जगत् तिष्ठति न स्वतन्त्रतम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said It appears that some of the most desperate and terrible gamblers who always depend on deceit (in their play) are present there. The whole universe, however, is at the will of its creator under the control of Fate. It is not free.

sa: कथं च राजा पुत्रं तमुपेक्षेताल्पचेतसम्। दुर्योधनं पाण्डुपुत्रान् कोपयानं महारथान्॥
en: Why did the king thus permit his narrowminded son Duryodhana to excite the anger of those mighty warriors, the sons of Pandu?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं श्रुत्वा व्यवसितो निकृतिं समुपाश्रितः। जितमित्येव शकुनियुधिष्ठिरमभाषत।॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard this, and adopting unfair means, Shakuni, ever ready with the dice said to Yudhishthira, “Lo, I have won?"

sa: न प्रदास्यति चेद् राज्यमितो वर्षे चतुर्दशे। दुर्योधनोऽभिसत्कृत्य सत्यमेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: All this will surely happen if on the fourteenth year from this, Duryodhana does not return us our kingdom with proper respect.

sa: उत्सृज्य बाष्पं शनकै राजमातेदमब्रवीत्। भगिन्या दुहिता मेऽसि पिप्लुनानेन सूचिता॥
en: Shedding tcars and in a low voice, the Queen-mother said, 'Know by this your mole, you are the daughter of my sister.

sa: ततो वैतरणी गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रमोचनीम्। विरजं तीर्थमासाद्य विराजति यथा शशी॥
en: Then one should go to Vaitarini, which destroys all sins. Going then to the Tirtha, called Viraja, one shines like the moon.

sa: न तु मामजहात् प्रज्ञा यावदद्येति पाण्डव। तस्यैवानुग्रहाद् राजन्नगस्त्यस्य महात्मनः॥
en: But, O Pandava, even till now I have not lost my memory. And it is by the grace of the highsouled Agastya,

sa: ततोऽहं शरजालेन दिव्यास्त्रनुदितेन च। व्यगृहणं सह दैतेयैस्तत् पुरं पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: And, O best of the Bharatas, I assailed that city together with the Daityas by showers of arrows, shot from celestials weapons.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा धृतराष्ट्रो मनीषी दैवं मत्वा परमं दुस्तरं च। शशासोच्चैः पुरुषान् पुत्रवाक्ये स्थितो राजा दैवसम्मूढचेताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this the weak-minded Dhritarashtra considered that Fate was supreme (in this world). The king (Dhritarashtra), deprived of his (good) sense by Fate and obedient to the words of his son, loudly commanded his men (saying),

sa: न ह्यदैवकृतं किंचिन्नराणामिह विद्यते। न च मे बालभावेऽपरि किंचित् पापकृतं कृतम्॥ कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यदिदं दुःखमागतम्।
en: Indeed, there exists nothing of men that does not fall within the category of destiny. I had committed no crime even in my childhood, either in action, thought or speech, for which reason this great calamity might befall me.

sa: लोमशप्रभृतींस्तांस्तु महर्षीच समाहितान्। स्नातुं विनिर्गतान् दृष्ट्वा पुष्पार्थं च तपोधनान्॥
en: And when he saw that the self-controlled great Rishis and ascetics, Lomasha and others, had gone to bathe or to collect flowers,

sa: तदिहाप्सरसस्तात गन्धर्वाश्च सदानघ। तस्य वीरस्य चरितं गायन्तो रमयन्ति माम्॥
en: O child, O sinless one, since then Apsaras and the Gandharvas delight me by singing the great deeds of that great hero,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तेषु तत्रोपविष्टेषु देवर्षिरपि नारदः। आजगाम विशुद्धात्मा पाण्डवानवलोककः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When they were all seated the divine saint Narada too, of pure soul, came there to see the Pandavas.

sa: तथैवधाता भूतानामिष्टानिष्टफलप्रदः। यदि न स्यान्न भूतानां कृपणो नाम कश्चन॥
en: If God himself were not the bestower of good or bad fruits then among creatures there would not be any miserable being.

sa: स मामुवाच तेजस्वी कृपयाभिपरिप्लुतः। मोक्षस्ते भविता राजन् कस्माच्चित् कालपर्ययात्॥
en: (At which) that energetic sage, filled with pity, replied to me "you will get rid of it after the expiration some time."

sa: अथ क्षिप्तः शरो घोरो मयापि द्विजसत्तम। ताडितश्च ऋषिस्तेन शरेणानतपर्वणा॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, I too shot a swift and fearful arrow. A Rishi was wounded by that arrow with head bent.

sa: सोऽयं मयाभ्यनुज्ञातस्त्वया च पृथिवीपतिः। करोतु स्वमभिप्रायं मास्य विघ्नकरो भव॥
en: Permitted both by me and you, let this king do what he wishes. Do not stand as on obstacle in his way.

sa: ततो भागररथीतीरात् कुरुक्षेत्रं जगाम सः। सानुगो नृपतिर्वृद्धो नियतः संयतेन्द्रियः॥
en: From the banks of the Bhagirathi the old king, with his followers, observing vows and with senses controlled, then proceeded to Kurukshetra.

sa: न हि दोषो मम मतः कथं वा मन्यसे विभो। इत्येवमुक्तो विजयः प्रसन्नात्माब्रवीदिदम्॥ सर्वे मे सुप्रियं देवि यदेतत् कृतवत्यसि।
en: I cannot be held, O powerful one, to have committed any sin. How, indeed, would you hold me censurable? Thus addressed (by Ulupi), Vijaya became cheerful of heart and said to her, All this you have done, O goddess, is highly agreeable to me.

sa: एतद् वः सर्वमाख्यातं मया विप्रर्षिसत्तमाः। एवमाचरत क्षिप्रं ततः सिद्धिमवाप्स्यथ॥
en: I have now described everything to you, O foremost of twice-born Rishis! Do you act thus immediately, you will then acquire success.

sa: तदा संधाय शक्रेण पप्रच्छर्नृपतिं वसुम्। धर्मसंशयमापन्नान् सत्यं ब्रूहि महामते॥
en: All of them exhausted with disputation. The Rishis, then, those beholders of truth, having made a compact with Shakra, asked king Vasu.

sa: तं सीदमानं जग्राह भीमः कृष्णेन चोदितः। मैवमित्यब्रवीच्चैनं कृष्णः परबलार्दनः॥
en: Then, asked by Krishna, Bhima pulled him up from sinking. This must not be so, said Krishna, the anihilator of hostile armies.

sa: चतुरो वार्षिकान् मासान् यो मांसं परिवर्जयेत्। चत्वारि भद्राण्यवाप्नोति कीर्तिमायुर्यशोबलम्॥
en: He who abstains from meat for the four months of the rainy season, acquires the blessed achievements, viz., longevity, fame and power.

sa: अभिमन्योर्यथा जातः परिक्षित् परवीरहा॥ तथायं सुरथाज्जातो मम पौत्रो महाभुजः।
en: As that destroyer of hostile heroes, Parikshit, has been born of Abhimanyu, so has this mighty-armed child, my grandson, originated from Suratha.

sa: हिरण्यदानं गोदानं पृथिवीदानमेव च। एतानि वै पवित्राणि तारयन्त्यपि दुष्कृतम्॥
en: Gift of gold, gift of kine, and gift of earth,-these are considered as sincleansing. They rescue the giver from his evil deeds.

sa: सा पुत्रान् रुदतः सर्वान् मुहुर्मुहुरवेक्षती। जगामैव महाप्राज्ञा वनाय कृतनिश्चया॥
en: Highly wise and firmly resolved on retirement from the world, the blessed dame walked on, frequently loO king at her weeping children.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। नारदस्य च संवादं पुंश्चल्या पञ्चचूडया॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old history of the discourse between the celestial Rishi Narada and the (celestial) courtezan Panchachuda.

sa: ततस्त्वादाय दारुणि गन्यांश्च विविधान् बहून्॥ चितां चक्रुर्महात्मान पाण्डवा विदुरस्तथा।
en: Then the great Pandavas and Vidura, taking a large quantity of wood and various kinds of fragrant scents, made a funeral pyre.

sa: दत्तवान् गौतमस्यैतदङ्गिरा वै पहातपाः। अङ्गिरा: समनुज्ञातः काश्यपेन च धीमता॥
en: Angiras endued with great ascetic merit, had delivered this discourse to Gautama. Angiras himself had got it from the highly intelligent Kashyapa.

sa: अभिमन्योश्च बालस्य विनाशं रणमूर्धनि। कर्णस्य च महाबाहो संग्रामेप्वपलायिनः॥ तथैव द्रौपदेयानामन्येषां सुहृदामपि। वधं संस्मृत्य ते वीरा नानिप्रमनसोऽभवन्॥
en: Indeed, thinking of the destruction of the youthful Abhimanyu on the field of battle, of the mighty-armed Karna who never retreated from fight, of the sons of Draupadi, and of other friends of theirs, those heroes became highly dispirited.

sa: प्रभावशास्मि ते कृष्ण तस्मात् त्वां याचयाम्यहम्। कुरुष्व पाण्डुपुत्राणामिमं परमनुग्रहम्॥
en: I know your power, O Krishna! Therefore do I solicit you! Do you show this great favour to the sons of Pandu.

sa: आर्जवं धर्ममित्याहुरधर्मो जिह्म उच्यते। आर्जवेनेह संयुक्तो नरो धर्मेण युज्यते॥
en: Sincerity, it has been said, is Virtue; while insincerity or crookedness is sin. That man who acts sincerely becomes indeed with Virtue.

sa: ततस्त्रिंशद्गुणे काले लभते वैश्यतामपि। वैश्यतायां चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते॥
en: After thirty thousand years one is born as a Vaishya. There in that order, one has to pass a very long time.

sa: यद् यच्च कुरुते कर्म वा यदि वाशुभम्। पूर्वदेहकृतं सर्वमवश्यमुपभुज्यते॥
en: Whatever deeds, good or bad, the Individual Soul does in a former body, have certainly to be enjoyed or endured by him.

sa: अश्वमेधसहस्रं च सत्यं च तुलया धृतम्। अश्वमेधसहस्राद्धि सत्यमेव विशिष्यते॥
en: A thousand Horse-sacrifices and Truth were once weighed in the balance. It was seen that Truth weighed heavier than a thousand. Horsesacrifices.

sa: लक्षणं लक्षणेनैव वदनं वदनेन च। अविचेष्टन्नतिष्ठद् वै छायेवान्तहितो मुनिः॥
en: Penetrating her eyes with his eyes and her face with his face, Vipula lived, without moving within her invisibly, like her shadow.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच ज्येष्ठां स्वसारं पितरं मातरं च यथा शत्रु मदमत्ताश्चरन्ति। तथाविधानामेष लोको महर्षे परं गन्ता धृतराष्ट्रो न तत्र॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Only those persons who, intoxicated with pride, treat their eldest sister and father and mother as enemies, have to go, O great ascetic, to such a region. I shall go to a higher region. Indeed, Dhritarashtra shall not have to go there.

sa: सुवर्ण रजतं वस्त्रं मणिमुक्तावसूनि च। सर्वमेतन्महाप्राज्ञो ददाति वसुधां ददत्।॥
en: The wise man who makes gifts of earth, gives away all these, viz, gold, silver cloth, gems and pearls and precious stones.

sa: अहो भगवतो वीर्यं महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः। राज्ञश्चापि सभार्यस्य धैर्यं पश्यत यादृशम्॥
en: Great is the energy of the holy Rishi of purified soul! See also the endurance of the king and his royal spouse.

sa: चपलाक्षः किलातीव प्रियस्ते मधुसूदन। सुतं पश्य त्वमस्यैनं ब्रह्मास्त्रेण निपातितम्॥
en: Abhimanyu of restless eyes, O destroyer of Madhu, was exceedingly dear to you. Behold this child of his killed by the Brahma-weapon.

sa: स वध्यमानो वज्रेण तस्मिन्नमिततेजसा॥ विवेश सहसा ज्योतिर्जग्राह विषयं ततः।
en: And he (Vritra) smitten by the thunderbolt by the most powerful Indra went to the luminous matter and abstracted its inherent property.

sa: पुष्पाणि तानि दृष्ट्वा तु तदाङ्गेन्द्रवराङ्गना। भगिनी चोदयामास पुष्पार्थे चारुलोचना॥
en: Seeing those flowers on her hair, the queen of the Angas having beautiful eyes, urged her sister to obtain some for her.

sa: कृपं निवर्तयामास युयुत्सुं च महारथम्। धृतराष्ट्रो महीपाल परिदाप्य युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: King Dhritarashtra, however, caused Kripa and the powerful car-warrior Yuyutsu 10 refrain from following him. He made them over to Yudhishthira's hands.

sa: तं गृहीत्वा तु कौरव्य नागराजपतेः सुता। मन:प्रह्लादनीं वाचं सैनिकानामथाब्रवीत्॥
en: The daughter of the Prince of Snakes, taking it up, uttered these words which highly gladdened the combatants standing on the field.

sa: मधुरोऽम्लः कटुस्तिक्तः कषायो लवणस्तथा॥ एवं षड्विधविस्तारो रसो वारिमयः स्मृतः।
en: Sweet, sour, pungent, bitter, astringent, and saline likewise. Taste, which has been said to Belong to water, is thus of six varieties.

sa: इषीका द्रोणपुत्रेण भीमसेनार्थमुद्यता। सोत्तरायां निपतिता विजये मयि चैव ह॥
en: The blade of grass, uplifted by Drona's son for bringing about the destruction of Bhimasena, fell upon Uttara and Vijaya and myself.

sa: असुराणां प्रवृत्तस्तु दम्भभावः स्वभावजः। दानं देवा व्यवसिता दममेव महर्षयः॥
en: The tendency for ostentatious pride first arose in the Asuras. The celestials betook themselves to gifts, and the great Rishis to selfcontrol.

sa: अहं कर्ता हि सत्रस्य होता शुक्रस्य चैव ह। यस्य बीजं फलं तस्य शुक्रं चेत् कारणं मतम्।।१२०
en: I am the performer of this Sacrifice. I poured on the sacrificial fire, the seed that came out of myself. He who has planted the seed always enjoys the fruit. The principal cause of these births is my seed.

sa: अहोरात्रमिदं द्वन्द्वं तयोर्मध्ये हुताशनः। एतद् रूपमुदानस्य परमं ब्राह्मणा विदुः॥
en: Day and Night form a pair, Between them is the Fire. That is the cxcellent seat of Udana as the Brahinanas know.

sa: जमदग्निरुवाच जाजमद्यजजानेऽहं जिजाहीह जिजायिषि। जमदग्निरिति ख्यातस्ततो मां विद्धि शोभने॥
en: Jamadagni said I have originated from the sacrificial fire of the celestials. Hence am I called Jamadagni, O you of beautiful features.

sa: एवं स तपसा राजन् धृतराष्ट्रो महामनाः। योजयामास चात्मानं तांश्चाप्यनुचरांस्तदा॥
en: Thus the great Dhritarashtra set himself to the practice of penances, and all his followers also to the same course of conduct.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा संक्रुद्धो वज्रदत्तो नराधिपः। प्रेषयामास कौरव्य वारणं पाण्डवं प्रति॥
en: Having said these words, O you of Kuru's race, king Vajradatta, filled with anger, urged his elephant towards the son of Pandu.

sa: ते चेद् भवन्ति राजेन्द्र ऋद्ध्यन्ते गृहमेधिनः। धूपप्रदानैर्दीपैश्च नमस्कारैस्तथैव च॥
en: Even such is the effect of the gift of lamps and of incense, as also of bows and prostrations, to the celestials.

sa: यद् यत् प्रदीयते दानमुत्तराविषये नरैः। महाफलमनन्तं तद् भवतीति विनिश्चयः॥
en: Whatever gifts are made by men under the constellation of Uttara-Phalguni yield great merit, which, again, becomes unending. This is very certain.

sa: बृहस्पतिरुवाच कृत्वा पापानि कर्माणि अधर्मवशमागतः। मनसा विपरीतेन निरयं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: Brihaspati said By committing sinful deeds with perverted mind, one gives way to the influence of sin, and accordingly goes to Hell.

sa: भगीरथ उवाच निष्काणां वै ह्यददं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः शतं सहस्राणि सदैव दानम्। ब्राह्यं व्रतं नित्यमास्थाय विद्वन् न त्वेवाहं तस्य फलादिहागाम्॥
en: Bhagiratha said I used to make gifts of hundred thousands of gold coins to the Brahmanas practising the vow of celibacy all the while. It is not by dint of the merit of those, gifts, O learned one, that I have acquired this region.

sa: एवं तदभवद् युद्धमहान्यष्टादश प्रभो। यत्र ते पृथिवीपाला निहताः स्वर्गमावसन्॥
en: Thus did that battle take place, O lord, for eighteen days. Many kings of Earth, killed therein, have ascended the celestial region.

sa: निवारितं गजं दृष्ट्वा भगदत्तसुतो नृपः। उत्ससर्ज शितान् बाणानर्जुनं क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥
en: Seeing his elephant impeded in its course, the royal son Bhagadatta, deprived of sense by anger, shot many whetted arrows at Arjuna.

sa: तत् समाप्य यथोद्दिष्टं पूर्वकर्म समाहितः। दातुं निर्वपणं सम्यग् यथावदहमारभम्॥
en: Having with concentrated mind performed all preliminary rites as laid down in the scriptures, I began to duly offer the obsequial cake.

sa: यजस्य मदनुज्ञातः प्राप्य एष क्रतुस्त्वया। युनक्तु नो भवान् कार्ये यत्र वाञ्छसि भारत॥ सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि सर्वे कर्तास्मि तेऽनघ।
