en: With my approval freely granted, do you worship the celestials in the sacrifice suggested. Do you, O Bharata, appoint us to whatever task you like. Truly, do I pledge myself that I shall accomplish all, O sinless one, that you may bid me accomplish,

sa: चित्रकूटे जनस्थाने तथा मन्दाकिनीजले। विगाह्य वै निराहारो राजलक्ष्म्या निषेव्यते॥
en: If one, fasting bathes at Chitrakuta and Janasthana and the waters of Mandakini, one is sure to be gifted with real prosperity.

sa: अभिवाद्य च शान्तात्मा स गुरुं गुरुवत्सलः। विपुलः पर्युपातिष्ठद् यथापूर्वमशङ्कितः॥
en: O tranquil soul and full of respect for his preceptor, Vipula respectfully saluted him and stood before him with a fearless heart.

sa: यस्तु वर्षशतं पूर्णे तपस्तप्येत सुदारुणम्। यश्चैव वर्जयेन्मांसं सममेतन्मतं मम॥
en: He who practises severe austerities for a century, and he who abstains from ineat, are both equally meritorious. This is my opinion.

sa: सद्यो ददाति यश्चान्नं सदैकाग्रमना नरः। न स दुर्गाण्यवाप्नोतीत्येवमाह पराशरः॥
en: He, who always makes gifts of food, with attention, to the righteous, never suffers any distress. This has been said by Parashara.

sa: तस्य कालपरीमाणमकरोत् स पितामहः। भूतेषु परिवृत्तिं च पुनरावृत्तिमेव च॥
en: Of that (acceptance of body), thc Grandfather put down a limit about time, and migrations among various creatures and return or re-birth.

sa: मोदकैः पायसेनाथ मांसापूपैस्तथैव च। आशास्य च महात्मानं प्रययुर्मुदिता भृशम्॥
en: Pleasing that great deity with Modakas and frumenty and with cakes made of meat, the sons of Pandu started with cheerful hearts.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अयमायाति भगवान् बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः। पृच्छैनं सुमहाभागमेतद् गुह्यं सनातनम्॥
en: Bhishma said Yonder comes the illustrious and highly intelligent Brihaspati. Do you ask his blessed self. The subject is an eternal mystery.

sa: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रीता: सर्वे दिवौकसः। प्रशशंसुर्द्विजांश्चापि ब्राह्मणांश्च यशस्विनः॥
en: Hearing these words of Narada, the dwellers of Heaven became highly pleased. They also lauded those regenerate and illustrious allies of theirs.

sa: द्वादश्यामीहमानस्य नित्यमेव प्रदृश्यते। रजतं बहुवित्तं च सुवर्णं च मनोरमम्॥
en: By performing the Shraddha on the twelfth day, one always sees if he desires various sorts of beautiful silver and gold articles.

sa: यदिदं चापलात् कर्म सर्वान् मोश्चिकीर्षति। मन:प्रति सुतीक्ष्णाग्रानहं मोक्ष्यामि सायकान्॥
en: Since on account of its unsteadiness, it sets all mortals to perform acts, I shall shoot very sharp-pointed arrows at the mind!

sa: मम चाप्यन्तरात्माऽयं शुद्धं वेत्ति विभीषणम्। अनुमानाच्च भावाच्च सर्वतः सुपरीक्षितः॥
en: Truly does my inner self regard Vibhīşana as devoid of any wicked intention. He has been well sounded by signs and gestures.

sa: स सारथिमुवाचेदं याहि यत्रैष वानरः। क्षयमेव हि नः कुर्याद्राक्षसानामुपेक्षितः॥
en: Thereat, be* addressed his charioteer, saying, "Go where the monkeys is. Being disregarded by the Raksasas, he makes havoc among us." *Indrajit.

sa: ततस्तेन दशग्रीवो यक्षेन्द्रेण महात्मना। गदयाभिहतो मूर्ध्नि न च स्थानात्प्रकम्पितः॥
en: Then Daśagrīva on being Struck in the head with the mace by the lord of Yakşas, did not move from his place.

sa: निरुद्धा रावणेनाहमल्पवीर्येण रक्षसा। समर्थः खलु मे भर्ता रावणं हन्तुमाहवे॥
en: I have been captured by Rāvana, a Rākşasa of feeble prowess. Forsooth my lord is capable of slaying this Rāvana in conflict.

sa: न नो देवकृतं किंचिद्भयमस्ति कदाचन। मानुषानो भयं राजंस्तुमुलं संप्रबाधते॥
en: No fear anywise springs to us fro the Deities. But, О king, a great fear does cross us, coming from a mortal.

sa: दशग्रीवं जयेत्याहुरसुराः समवस्थिताः। देवा राममथोचुस्ते त्वं जयेति पुनः पुनः॥
en: The Asuras staying there said to the Tennecked one, Be victorious and the celestials again and again said to Rāma, 'Be victorious'!

sa: ततोऽम्बरे महाञ्छब्दः साधुसाध्विति चोत्थितः। आहत्य राक्षसो विष्णुं गरुडं चाप्यताडयत्॥
en: And now there arose a mighty tumult in the sky of 'Excellent!' 'Excellent!' and having struck Visnu, the Raksasa also hit Garuda.

sa: एवं विज्ञाप्यमानं तं सुग्रीवं वानरर्षभम्। अपृच्छत्तं महाप्राज्ञो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा॥
en: The highly intelligent Lakşmaņa, the slayer of foes, addressed Sugriva, the foremost O the monkeys, while he was thus being informed, saying.

sa: स बभूव रणे घोरस्तयोर्बाणमयश्चयः। अग्निभ्यामिव दीप्ताभ्यां सत्रे कुशमयश्च यः॥
en: In that field, the vollies of their shafts were dreadful to behold like to a heap of Kusa aflame in a sacrifice.

sa: अज्ञातरूपैः पुरुषैः स राजन्पृच्छ्यतामिति। यदुक्तमत्र मे प्रेक्षा काचिदस्ति समीक्षिता॥
en: And what they have said, O king, as regards sounding him through secret spies, appear to me as one requiring great wisdom.

sa: निवार्यमाणस्य मया हितैषिणा न रोचते ते वचनं निशाचर। परान्तकाले हि गतायुषो नरा हितं न गृह्णन्ति सुहृद्भिरीरितम्॥
en: What, I spoke to you, O ranger of the night, to prevent you, for your welfare, did not please you. Persons, whose lease of life is well-nigh expired, do not pay heed to the well-meaning words of their friends.

sa: वर्तमाने तथा घोरे सङ्ग्रामे लोमहर्षणे।। रुधिरौघा महाघोरा नद्यस्तत्र विसुनुवुः॥
en: And as the mighty envounter, capable of making people's hair stand on end, went on, there flowed a fearful river of gore.

sa: एष जेष्यति काकुत्स्थौ सुग्रीवं च महाबलम्। वानरांश्चापरान्धोरान्हनिष्यति न संशयः॥
en: He will conquer the Kākutsthas, as well as sugrīva endowed with exceeding strength, and, without doubt, slay all the other dreadful monkeys.

sa: नूनं राक्षसकन्यानां रुदतीनां गृहे गृहे। श्रोष्यामि नचिरादेव दुःखार्तानामिह ध्वनिम्॥
en: For certain, shall I soon hear the cries and groans in every house, of the daughters of the Rākşasas worn with grief.

sa: तामपि प्रहितां शक्तिं रावणेन बलीयसा। यत्नतस्ते हरिश्रेष्ठा न शेकुरवमर्दितुम्॥
en: In spite of all their efforts, the foremost monkeys failed to extract the dart which had been hurled by the powerful Rāvaņa.

sa: इष्टबन्धुजनो नित्यं मां स नित्यमनुव्रतः। इमामवस्थां गमितो राक्षसैः कूटयोधिभिः॥
en: Ever seeking my welfare and ever devoted to me, he has been reduced to this pass by Rākṣasas fighting in crooked ways.

sa: अमात्यैः सहितः सर्वैः प्रहस्तस्त्वामुपस्थितः। तेन दर्शनकामन अहं प्रस्थापितः प्रभो॥
en: Prahasta has come to you, surrounded by all the courtiers. And, O lord, I was despatched by him, desirous of seeing you.

sa: तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। जानुभ्यामगमद्भूमौ चचाल च पपात च॥
en: And boxed (by Hanumāna), Ravana-lord of the Rākşasas-went down to the ground on his knees, and shook and dropped to the earth.

sa: प्रवादः सत्यमेवायं त्वां प्रति प्रायशो नृप॥ पतिव्रतानां नाकस्मात्पतन्त्यश्रूणि भूतले।
en: O kin, the saying, that the tears of chaste damsels do not uselessly fall on the ground, has been verified (here) forsooth.

sa: अञ्जना सुप्रजा येन मातरिश्वा च सुव्रत। हनूमान्वानरश्रेष्ठः प्राणान्धारयते क्वचित्॥
en: Does he through whom Añjanä as well as Mātariśvan* are blessed with fair offspring, does that prince of monkeys-Hanumān, live? *The wind-god.

sa: ततस्तु सचिवैः सार्धं राक्षसो भीमविक्रमः। ननाद सुमहानादं कम्पयनिव मेदिनीम्॥
en: Thereat the Räksasa of terrific prowess along with his councillors began to set up tremendous shouts; as if making the earth tremble.

sa: अन्तर्हितैश्चापि तथान्तरिक्षे ब्रह्मर्षिभिश्चैव सुरर्षिभिश्च। र्मामेति चोक्त्वा महता स्वरेण ॥
en: Then remaining invisible in the sky, Brahmarsis and Surarsis,* exclaiming, Well-aday! and Do'nt, in loud accents ajaculated, (Oh! and alas!) *Celestial saints.

sa: मेघाः क्रव्यादसंकाशाः परुषाः परुषस्वराः। क्रूराः क्रूरं प्रवर्षन्ते मिश्रं शोणितबिन्दुभिः॥
en: The clouds are goblinish; and fierce; and harsh-sounding. And wearing terrific looks, they fiercely pour down showers mixed with drops of blood.

sa: उद्दिष्टं दीर्घमायुस्ते दैवज्ञैरपि राघव। अनृतं वचनं तेषामल्यायुरसि राघव ॥
en: O Rāghava, even the astrologers had predicted long life for you. But their words are false, you, O Rāghava, wast short-lived. me

sa: एवमुक्तः सुरसया प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतः स्थितः। विवर्णवदनो भूत्वा वाक्यं चेदमुदीरयम्॥
en: Thus addressed by Surasā, I, remaining in humble guise with joined hands, and with my countenance turned pale, I uttered these words,

sa: कथं सर्वगुणैींना गुणवन्तं महोजसम्। सुमुखं दुर्मुखी रामं कामयामास राक्षसी॥
en: Why did that ugly-faced she-demon, devoid of all qualities, address Räma, having a beautiful countenance, gifted with many virtues and great effulgence?

sa: ते बद्धघण्टा बलिनो घोररूपा निशाचराः। विनद्यमानाः संहृष्टा धूम्राक्षं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: And those powerful and dreadful nightrangers, bursting with high spirits, with bells tied to their arms, set up shouts, and surrounded Dhumraksa.

sa: स ता दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्महासत्त्वो महाबलः। चकार सुमहदूपं राक्षसीनां भयावहम्॥
en: And observing them, that mighty-armed and powerful monkey endowed with immense strength, magnified his dimension, capable of striking terror into the Rākşasas.

sa: पुनरावृत्ततोयां च ददर्श स महाकपिः। प्रसन्नामिव कान्तस्य कान्तां पुनरुपस्थिताम्॥
en: And that great monkey beheld further down the stream turning back like to the damsel, pleased, going back to her dear one.

sa: यद्यधर्मो भवेद्भूतो रावणो नरकं व्रजेत्। भवांश्च धर्मसंयुक्तो नैव व्यसनमाप्नुयात्॥
en: If unrighteousness would bring unhappiness on creatures, Ravana should hence to hell, and you possessed of virtue, should not come by misfortune.

sa: युद्धे हतो महाराज लक्ष्मणेन तवात्मजः। विभीषणसहायेन मिषतां नो महाद्युतिः॥
en: O mighty monarch, in our very sight your exceedingly effulgent son has been slain by Lakş maņa with the help of Vibhīşaņa.

sa: वीर्योत्सिक्तस्य शूरस्य संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिनः। बलिनो वीर्ययुक्तस्य भार्यात्वं किं न लिप्ससे॥
en: Do you not desire to be his wife, who is heroic, of indomitable prowess and who dose not turn back in battle?

sa: प्रणयाद्बहुमानाच्च सौहार्देन च राघव। प्रसादयामि प्रेष्योऽहं न खल्वाज्ञापयामि ते॥
en: O Rāma, out of love, honour, and brotherly feeling, I do crave your premising. I am a servant I cannot command you.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा रावणसुतो वञ्चयित्वा वनौकराः प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्का रथहेतोरमित्रहा ! १८ ।। स रथं भूषयित्वाथ रुचिरं हेगभूषितम्। प्रासासिशरसंयुक्तं युक्तं परमवाजिभिः॥ अधिष्ठितं हयज्ञेन सूतेनाप्तोपदेशिला। आरुरोह महातेजा रावणिः समितिजसः ॥
en: Saying this, that slayer of foes-Rávana's son. deceiving the wood-rangers, entered the ciiy of Lankā for providing himself with a (freah) car And embeilishing a chariot, graceful and adorned with gold, furnished with prāsas and swords and arrows, yoked with superb steeds, and driven by a charioteer, knowing horses and possessed of instructions (anent his art), that victor in battle-the exceedingly energetic son of Ravana-ascended it,

sa: कुशलं नो महाबाहो सर्वत्र रघुनन्दन॥ त्वां तु दिष्ट्या कुशलिनं पश्यामो हतशात्रवम्। दिष्ट्या त्वया हतो राजन्रावणो लोकरावणः॥
en: O son of Raghu. O mighty-armed one, complete welfare is ours. By good luck it is that we see you fortunate, with all your foes finished. Bygood luck it is that, Oking, Ravana-destroyer of creatures, has been slain byyou.

sa: गदापरिघहस्तौ तौ युधि वीरौ समीयतुः। नर्दन्तौ गोवृषप्रख्यौ घनाविव सविद्युतौ॥
en: Those two heroes, with club and parigha in their hands, engaged in battle, roaring like two bulls or clouds accompanied with lightning.

sa: अथवाहं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैभिन्नगात्रं महाहवे। भवद्भिः श्वो निरन्तास्मि रामं लोकस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Or I shall slay him to morrow in the presence of all, wounded by you in the mighty encounter with sharpened arrows.

sa: अगस्त्यं त्वब्रवीद्रामः सत्मेतच्छ्रुतं च मे॥ एवं राम समुद्भुतो रावणो लोककण्टकः। सपुत्रो येन सङ्गामे जितः शक्रः सुरेश्वरः॥
en: Thereupon Rāma said to Agastya-All, you have said, is true. And Agastya said Rāma, Rāvaņa, the thorn of people, then grew in power, by whom, in the company of his son, Indra, the lord of the celestials, was defeated.

sa: अशोभत तदा रामो धनुर्विस्फारयन्महत्। भगवानिव संक्रुद्धो भवो वेदमयं धनुः॥
en: And drawing his redoubtable bow, Rāma appeared like the reverend enraged Bhava, drawing his bow having sounds, and instinct with Brahma energy.

sa: सा ज्वलन्तीव रोषेण दहन्तीव निशाचरम्। उवाचाग्नि समाधाय मरणाय कृतत्वरा॥
en: Then, flaming up in ire and as if consuming the night-ranger, she, preparing a funeral pyre, hastened to make away with herself.

sa: ततः शरान्दाशरथिः संधायामित्रकर्षणः। ससर्ज राक्षसेन्द्राय क्रुद्धः सर्प इव श्वसन्॥
en: Then sighing like an enraged serpent, that chastiser of foes, Dasaratha's son, setting shafts (on his bow-string) showered them on the Raksasa-chief.

sa: अस्मिञ्जीवति वीरे तु हतमप्यहतं बलम्। हनूमत्युज्झितप्राणे जीवन्तोऽपि मृता वयम्॥
en: While this hero is alive, this force, albeit destroyed, live; but if Hanumān is reft of life, although living, we are destroyed.

sa: अस्मित्रत्रहते सैन्ये वानराणां तरस्विनाम्। यो यो धारयते प्राणांस्तं तमाश्वासयावहे॥
en: The host of the quick-paced monkeys has been slain by this weapon. Let us go and console them who are still living.

sa: चारेण तु सुयुक्तेन शत्रोः शक्तिमवेक्षता। गूढेन चरता तावदवेक्षितमिदं मया॥ राक्षसानां विशेषश्च पुरी चेयं निरीक्षिता। राक्षसाधिपतेरस्य प्रभावो रावणस्य च॥
en: Truly have I seen her today, engaged as I have been as a spy to estimate the strength of the enemy and am ranging secretly everywhere. I have seen minutely the city of the Rākşasas, and the strength of Rāvana the lord of Rākşasas.

sa: स भिन्नो नैकधा शूलो दिव्यहाटकमण्डितः।। व्यशीर्यत महोल्केव रामबाणादितो भुवि॥
en: That flaming dart, feathered in gold, being splintered into several pieces by Rāma's arrows fell down on earth like a huge fire-brand.

sa: स प्रविश्य पुरीं लङ्कां रामबाणभयादितः। भग्नदर्पस्तदा राजा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रिथः॥
en: Entering the city of Larkā, the king afflicted with the fear of Rāma's arrows, with his pride humbled, was undergoing great torments:

sa: दैत्यानां किल धर्मज्ञ पुरेयं वसनार्णवा॥ सपर्वता मही वीर तेऽभवन्प्रभविष्णवः। निहत्य तांस्तु समरे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ॥ देवानां वशमानीतं त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्ययम्।
en: O you cognisant of righteousness, formerly this earth, O hero, having the ocean for her garment, and furnished with mountains, belonged to the Daityas; and (gradually) they grew very powerful. And then this undeteriorating triune world was brought under the dominion of the celestials.

sa: स तां स्त्रीरूपविकृतां दृष्ट्वा वानरपुङ्गवः। आबभाषेऽथ मेधावी सत्त्ववान् प्लवगर्षभः॥
en: Seeing her appear in the form of a deformed female, that foremost and best-of monkeys endued with intelligence, possessed of prowess, said.

sa: तत्प्रवृत्तं महाद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम। अन्तरिक्षे च भूमौ च पुनश्च गिरिमूर्धनि ॥ देवदानवयक्षाणां पिशाचोरगरक्षसाम्। पश्यतां तन्महाद्धं सर्वरात्रमवर्तत॥
en: That dreadful and huge conflict, capable of making hairs stand on end, continued for seven nights before the eyes of the celestials, Dānavas, Yaksas, Piśācas, Uragas and serpents stationed in the sky, on the earth or on the mountain-tops.

sa: धूम्राक्षेण समागम्य माणिभद्रो महारणे। मुसलेनोरसि क्रोधात्ताडितो न च कम्पितः॥
en: And Dhūmrākşa, confronting Māņibhadra in the mighty conflict hit him as the chest with a bludgeon; but he did not move thereat.

sa: ते कपि तं समासाद्य तोरणस्थमवस्थितम्। अभिपेतुर्महावेगाः पतङ्गा इव पावकम्॥
en: Having come near that monkey staying at the main entrance, those swelling spirits rushed on, even as insects rush into a flame.

sa: ख्यातः प्राज्ञः कृतज्ञश्च सानुक्रोशश्च राघवः। सवृत्तो निरनुक्रोशः शङ्के मद्भाग्यसंक्षयात्॥
en: Rāghava is grateful, true, wise and kind. I fear it is through my ill-luck that he dose not feel pity for me.

sa: तदेत्कथितं सर्वं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। हनूमतो बालभावे कर्मैतत्कथितं मया।॥
en: All what was asked by you has been said. The facts of Hanumān performed in childhood has also been related by me.

sa: मसक्तमन्यांश्च तलैर्जधान। समेत्य कैश्चित् कलहं चकार तथैव साम्नोपजगाम कांश्चित्॥
en: He used harsh words, undauntedly towards some, struck the weak with his palm, quarrelled with some, and consoled others with soothing words.

sa: अपि चास्मिन्हते नान्यं राजन् पश्यामि खेचरम्। तस्मान्नास्य वधे यत्नः कार्यः परपुरंजय। भवान् सेन्द्रेषु देवेषु यत्नमास्थातुमर्हति ॥
en: O king, if this one be slain, no other skyranger whatever would show himself tous. Threfore, O captor of hostile capitals, do not seek to slay this one. You should spend yourself on celestials with Indra (at their head).

sa: नैर्ऋतः क्रोधशोकाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां तु परिमूर्च्छितः। खरपुत्रं विशालाक्षं मकराक्षमचोदयत्॥ गच्छ पुत्र मयाज्ञप्तो बलेनाभिसमन्वितः। राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव जहि तौ सवनौकसौ॥
en: Being beside himself, simultaneously with wrath and grief Rāvana* spoke to Makarāksa, Kahara's son, having spacious eyes, saying, O child, do you proceed at my command with the army and destroy Rāghava and Laksmana with all the monkeys. *Nairta is another name of Ravana.

sa: पश्चिमेन तु रामस्य सुषेणः सहजाम्बवान्॥ अदूरान्मध्यमे गुल्मे तस्थौ बहुबलानुगः।
en: On the west of Rāma, Jāmbavän along with Susena, followed by innumerable troops, remained hard by at the garrison in the minddle.

sa: प्रस्थितः स दशग्रीवः कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्। ज्वलद्भास्करसंकाशं प्रविवेश निवेशनम् ॥
en: And that Ten-necked one, strode away as if shaking the whole earth and passed within (his queen's) abode resembling the effulgent Sun.

sa: कुद्धेन च तदा राजन्मारीचेन युयुत्सुना। निमेथान्तरमात्रेण द्वे सहस्र निपातिते॥
en: O king, in the twinkling of an eye Märīca, waxing wroth and eager for encounter brought down two thousand (of enemy's soldiers).

sa: ज्ञात्वा तस्य तु तद्वृत्तं भरद्वाजो महामुनिः। ददौ विश्रवसे भार्यां स्वसुतां देववर्णिनीम्॥ प्रतिगृह्य तु धर्मेण भरद्वाजसुतां तदा। प्रजान्वीक्षिकया बुद्ध्या श्रेयो ह्यस्य विचिन्तयन्॥ मुदा परमया युक्तो विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः। स तस्यां वीर्यसंपन्नमपत्यं परमाद्भुतम्॥ जनयामास धर्मज्ञः सर्वैर्ब्रह्मगुणैर्वृतम्। तस्मिञ्जाते तु संहृष्टः स बभूव पितामहः॥ दृष्ट्वा श्रेयस्करी बुद्धिं धनाध्यक्षो भविष्यति। नाम चास्याकरोत्प्रीतः सार्धं देवर्षिभिस्तदा॥ यस्माद्विश्रवसोऽपत्यं सादृश्याद्विश्रवा इव। तस्माद्वैश्रवणो नाम
en: Learning of his ways, that mighty ascetic, Bharadvāja, gave to Visravā for his wife, his daughter, Devavarņinſ. And having religiously wed Bhāradvāja's daughter, that foremost of ascetics, Visravā, conceiving the highest delight, began to reflect on the welfare of his offspring with an intelligence concentrated on them. And on her that one cognisant of righteousness begot child, exceedingly wonderful, endowed with energy, and adorned with all Brahma* qualities. On his having been born, his grand-father was rejoiced, and, marking the profitable intelligence (of the boy, he thought that) he would be the lord of riches. And well-pleased, (Pulastya) in company with the Devarsis (thought), Inasmuch as this is Viśravá's offspring, and as he resembles Viśravā himself, so he should be known by the

sa: तस्मिन्दग्धे तदा कुक्षौ समुद्रः सरितां पतिः। राघवं सर्वशास्त्रज्ञमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: On that place being burnt up, that lord of streams, the Ocean, thus spoke to Rāghava, versed in every branch of learning.

sa: स समाश्वासितस्तेन सुग्रीवेण महात्मना। उत्थाय स महाप्राज्ञो वाक्यं दधिमुखोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Being thus addressed hopefully by the highsouled Sugrīva, Dadhimukha, gifted with an intelligence of a very high order, rose up and spoke.

sa: इत्येवं ब्रुवतस्तस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः। खिनः शिथिलया वाचा लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: When the high-souled Raghava had spoken thus, Lakşmaņa, aggrieved on account of the words (of Rāghava) expressive of infirmity of purpose, said.

sa: कथं शूर्पणखा वृद्धा कराला निर्णतोदरी। आससाद वने रामं कंदर्पसमरूपिणम्॥
en: Alas! why did the aged and grim-visaged Śūrpanakhă, having her belly extending down ward, behold in the forest Rāma graceful like Kandarpa.

sa: अहं सेतुं करिष्यामि विस्तीर्णे मकरालये। पितुः सामर्थ्यमासाद्य तत्त्वमाह महोदधिः।॥
en: Resorting to my sire's skill, I will build a bridge over the spacious abode of Makaras. The mighty Ocean has spoken justly.

sa: ददर्श स कपिस्तस्य बाहू शयनसंस्थितौ। मन्दरस्यान्तरे सुप्तौ महाही रुषिताविव॥
en: That monkey saw his arms resting on the bed, like to two beautiful and mighty serpents sleeping in the entrails of Mandara.

sa: पलायनेन चोद्दिष्टाः प्राणानक्षामहे वयम्। एकेन बहवो भग्ना यशोनाशं गमिष्यति॥
en: If we save our lives by flight, and if the many are brought down by one, we shall lose our fame utterly.

sa: समर्थश्चाप्यहं सेतुं कर्तुं वै वरुणालये। तस्मादद्यैव बध्नन्तु सेतुं वानरपुङ्गवाः॥
en: I also am capable of constructing a bridge over Varuna's abode. Therefore this very day let the foremost monkeys construct the bridge.

sa: तदिदं मेघसंकाशं विमानमिह तिष्ठति। येन यास्यसि यानेन त्वमयोध्यां गतज्वरः॥
en: That car resembling the cloud is in the city of Lanka, in which you shaft, relieved of your anxiety, repair to Ayodhyā.

sa: स लवयित्वा प्राकारं पद्भ्यां पर्वतसंनिभः। स ददर्श धनप्रख्यं वानरानीकमद्भुतम्॥
en: And leaping over the wall with his legs, that one resembling a mountain saw the wonderful array of the monkeys, resembling clouds.

sa: पादयोनिपपाताथ चतुर्भिः सह राक्षसैः। अब्रवीच्च तदा वाक्यं रामं प्रति विभीषणः॥ धर्मयुक्तं च युक्तं च सांप्रतं संप्रहर्षणम्।
en: Descending from the welkin with his devoted attendants the virtuous-souled Vibhisana, delighted, bowed to Rāma. And thereupon touching his feet along with four Rākşasas, Vibhisana addressed Rama, with words, fraught with piety, befitting the occasion and conducing to pleasure.

sa: असकृत्संयुगे भग्ना मया विमृदितध्वजाः। अशक्ताः प्रत्यनीकेषु स्थातुं मम सुरासुराः॥
en: The celestials and Asuras are incapable of withstanding me, defeated as they were by me in battle and their pennons struck down.

sa: इति प्रतिज्ञामारुह्य चरामि विपुलं तपः। एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं मया राक्षसपुङ्गव।॥
en: Having made this promise, I have been carrying on rigid austerities. Thus, o foremost of Raksasas. I have related to you everything.

sa: तस्य तच्छुशुभे तानं शरेणाभिहतं मुखम्। शरदीवाम्बुजं फुल्लं विद्धं भास्कररश्मिना॥
en: And pierced by the arrows, his coppery face looked beautiful like a blown autumnal red lotus shot at by the solar rays.

sa: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ । त्वत्सकाशं महाभागे नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः॥
en: O great damsel, these two princes, placing themselves on my back shall come to you like to the rising Sun and Moon.

sa: वानराश्च महासत्त्वाः प्रगृह्य विपुलाः शिलाः। प्रविश्यारिबलं भीमं जघ्नुस्ते सर्वराक्षसान्।८॥
en: The highly powerful monkeys too taking up huge crags dashed against the dreadful army of the enemies and crushed all the Rakşasas.

sa: संवर्त इव लोकानां युध्यतोरभवत्तदा। राक्षसानां च मुख्यस्य प्रेतानामीश्वरस्य च॥
en: The encounter that then took place between that foremost of Rākşasas and the lord of the Dead was like the universal upheaval.

sa: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि दश तस्यापचक्रमुः। धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य सत्पथे निष्ठितस्य च॥
en: Thus passed away ten thousand of that one putting forth exertions in behalf of religion, and established in the path of honesty.

sa: स तां शिलामापतन्ती दृष्ट्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवः। अपक्रम्य सुविक्रान्तः खङ्गेन प्राहरत्तदा॥
en: That highly powerful leading Rākṣasa, finding the crag about to fall, turned a little away and struck the monkey with his dagger.

sa: शाङ्गचापविनिर्मुक्ता वज्रतुल्याननाः शराः। विदार्य तानि रक्षांसि सुपुङ्खा विविशुः क्षितिम्॥
en: And dight with dainty feathered parts having heads, the shafts discharged from the śārnga, resembling thunder-bolts, riving those Rākşása, entered the earth.

sa: स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा वाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः। सीतामाश्रित्य तेजस्वी हनूमान् विललाप ह॥
en: Having reflected for some time, the powerful Hanumān, having his eyes full of tears bewailed on Siita's account (in the following strain).

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महाबाहुर्धनुश्चिच्छेद संयुगे। अष्टाभिरथ नाराचैः सूतं विव्याध राघवः॥
en: Thereupon being excited with ire, Rāghava of long arms sundered his (Raksasa's) bow in conflict and with eight Näräcas pierced the charioteer.

sa: दशकोटिसहस्राणि रक्षसां कामरूपिणाम्। मांसशोणितभक्ष्याणां लङ्कापुरनिवासिनाम्॥ स तैस्तु सहितो राजा लोकपालानयोधयत्। सह देवैस्तु ते भग्ना रावणेन दुरात्मना॥
en: His army consists of ten thousand kotis of Rākşasas, wearing shapes at will, inhabiting the city of Lankā, and living on flesh and gore. And with the Lokpalas and the celestials, they were all defeated by the vicious-souled Ravana.

sa: गृध्राश्च परिलीयन्ते पुरीमुपरि पीडिताः। उपपन्नाश्च संध्ये द्वे व्याहरन्त्यशिवं शिवाः॥
en: Vultures sit sadly and distressed upon the roofs of houses. During the two twilights, the jackals, coming in sight, utter ominous howls.

sa: अथाध्वनि परिश्रान्तमर्धरात्रे स्थितं बलम्। सुखसुप्तं समासाद्य चरितं प्रथमं चरैः॥
en: Then at midnight (my) spies coming to that host, thus stationed, fatigued from travel, and sleeping soundly (in consequence), first ranged it.

sa: लयित्वा पितृपथं विहगेन्द्रालयं शुभम्। गङ्गायमुनयोर्भीमं समतीत्य समागमम्॥ शृङ्गवेरपुरं प्राप्य गुहमासाद्य वार्यवान्। स वाचा शुभया हृष्टो हनूमानिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then crossing the Wind-path and the abode of the birds, getting over the terrible confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā, reaching the city of Śțrgavera and meeting Guha, the energetic Hanumān, delighted (addressed him) with the following excellent words.

sa: यदैव नगरी लङ्का दुष्प्रवेशां सुरैरपि।॥ प्रविष्टो हनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैव व्यथिता वयम्।
en: We were sore-distressed when Hanuman, by his own prowess, entered the city of Lanka incapable of being approached even by the celestials.

sa: घोषेण महता घोषं सागरस्य समुच्छ्रितम्। भीममन्तर्दधे भीमा तरन्ती हरिवाहिनी।॥
en: That dreadful array of monkeys crossing over, with its mighty uproar drowned the dreadful roar of the deep, which had been arising.

sa: स्त्रैलोक्यनाथेन जनार्दनेन। ते तें गतास्तनिलयं नरेन्द्राः क्रोधोऽपि देवस्य वरेण तुल्यः॥ श्रुत्वा ततस्तद्वचनं निशाचरः सनत्कुमारस्य मुखाद्विनिर्गतम्। तथा प्रहृष्टः स बभूव विस्मितः कथं न यास्यामि हरि महाहवे॥
en: O king, all the monarchs, slain by Janärddana, holding discuss and the lord of the triple world, attained to his own region; even his anger become like a boon." Hearing those words given vent to by the great ascetic Sanatkumar the night-ranger Råvaņa, being worked up with delight and surprise, began to meditate how he should enter into conflict with Hari.

sa: भव मैथिलि भार्या मे मोहमेतं विसर्जय। बह्वीनामुत्तमस्त्रीणां ममाग्रमहिषी भव॥
en: O Maithili, do you become my spouse, and renounce this delusion. Do you become the foremost queen of all my excellent wives.

sa: अयं त्वां सचिवैः सार्धं महात्मा रजनीचरः। अभिज्ञातस्य मायानां पृष्ठतोऽनुगमिष्यति॥
en: And accompanied by his counsellors, this high-souled night-ranger shall follow at you back, in this engagement with that one skilled in illusion.

sa: प्रभ्रष्टोऽथ करात्तस्य प्रतोदः सारथेस्तदा। पपात सहसा दैवाद्ध्वजस्तस्य तु रक्षसः॥
en: And all on a sudden the reins slipped off (the hands of) the charioteer and the flag of the Råkşasas dropped down.

sa: जिते महेन्द्रेऽतिबले रावणस्य सुतेन वै। प्रजापति पुरस्कृत्य ययुर्लङ्कां सुरास्तदा॥
en: The highly powerful Mahendra being thus defeated by Ravana's son, all the celestials, taking the patriarch Brahmä before them, went to Lanka.

sa: ते सत्त्वाः सत्त्वकर्तारं विनीतवदुपस्थिताः। किं कुर्म इति भाषन्तः क्षुत्पिपासाभयार्दिताः॥
en: Thereupon those creatures humbly presented themselves before the creator, saying, What shall we do? We are sore tried by hunger and thirst.

sa: नीरुजो निव्रणाश्चैव संपन्नबलपौरुषाः। समुत्थास्यन्ति हरयः सुप्ता निद्राक्षये यथा ॥
en: Let the monkeys gifted with their pristine strength and prowess rise up unhurt and healthy as if after the end of sleep.

sa: यदि मामिह जानीयाद् वर्तमानां हि राघवः। अद्य बाणैरभिक्रुद्धः कुर्याल्लोकमराक्षसम्॥
en: If Rāghava could know that I was here, he, exceedingly wroth, would have cleared the earth with his arrows, of the Raksasas.

sa: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता सा सुग्रीवेण च वाहिनी। बभूव दुर्धर्षतरा सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः॥
en: That army, protected by Rāma and Lakşmaņa as well as Sugrīva, became and the more invincible even by the Asuras and celestials.

sa: चारास्तु ते तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रहृष्टा राक्षसेश्वरम्। शार्दूलमग्रतः कृत्वा ततश्चकुः प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: Thereat the spies, saying, So it is, taking Sardula to the fore, with delighted hearts went round the sovereign of the Raksasas.

sa: सोऽहं परुषितस्तेन दासवच्चावमानितः। त्यक्त्वा पुत्रांश्च दारांश्च राघवं शरणं गतः॥
en: Being reviled by him and treated harshly like a menial, I have come to seek Rāghava's shelter, renouncing my children and wives.

sa: सीतया च कृते शब्दे सहता राक्षसीगणः। नानाप्रहरणो घोर: समयादन्तकोपमः॥
en: And Sītā making a sudden noise, those terrible Rākṣasīs resembling Death himself and arined with various weapons, shall at once arrive there.

sa: महापार्थो महातेजा गदामादाय वीर्यवान्। विरराज गदापाणिः कुवेर इव संयुगे॥
en: The powerful Mahāpārsva endowed with terrific energy, taking his mace, appeared like Kuvera holding in his hand a mace in the encounter.

sa: नहि राज्यमधर्मेण भोक्तुं क्षणमपि त्वया। शक्यं मूर्खसहायेन पापेनाविदितात्मना ॥
en: For you, foolish, wicked, ignorant of selfknowledge, and having dolts for councillors, are not competent to unrighteously exercise kingship for a moment.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः कालाग्निरिव मूर्छितः। शरवर्षं महाघोरं तेषां मर्मस्वपातयत्॥
en: Thereupon the Ten-necked (demon), excited with wrath like the fire of dissolution, pierced them to their very vitals with highly dreadful arrows.

sa: विभीषणोऽपि धर्मात्मा सह तैर्नैऋतर्षभैः। लब्ध्वा कुलधनं राजा लङ्कां प्रायान्महायशाः॥
en: Having obtained his own kingdom, the greatly famous and virtuous souled Vibhīşaņa, with all the Rākşasas, repaired to the city of Lankā.

sa: दीना दीनस्वराः क्रूराः सर्वतो मृगपक्षिणः। प्रत्यादित्यं विनर्दन्ति जनयन्तो महद्भयम्॥
en: And on all sides birds and beasts, distressed, uttering woe-begone notes, and grim-visaged, set up cries against the sun, arousing great fear.

sa: कैकेयीं च वधिष्यामि सानुबन्धां सबान्धवाम्॥ कलुषेणाद्य महता मेदिनी परिमुच्यताम्।
en: I will also kill Kaikeyi along (with the humpbacked one, and her friends. Let the earth today be freed from foul sins.

sa: न हन्तव्यं न हन्तव्यमित्येवं दितिरब्रवीत्। निष्पपात ततः शक्रो मातुर्वचनगौरवात्॥
en: 'Do not slay it; do not slay it' said Diti. Thereupon, in consideration of the honour of his mother, Sakra went out.

sa: ततः समुद्रो धर्मात्मा समुत्थाय महाबलः। अब्रवीद् वचनं राजन्नसुरं कालचोदितम्॥
en: Thereat the righteous-souled and mighty Ocean arose and, O king, said these words to that Asura, who had been urged by Death.

sa: न जीवितं मेऽस्ति कुतः पुनः सुखं विनात्मजेनात्मवतां कुतो रतिः। ममाहितं देवि न कर्तुमर्हसि स्पृशामि पादावपि ते प्रसीद मे॥
en: My life itself is in jeopardy, where then is my happiness? Where is the happiness of parents without their sons? It behove you not, O noble dame, to do evil to me. I take hold of your feet; do you be propitious to me.

sa: अस्त्रेणोन्मुक्तमात्मानं ज्ञात्वा पैतामहाद् वरात्। मर्षयन् राक्षसान् वीरो यन्त्रिणस्तान् यदृच्छया॥
en: Then knowing that in virtue of the grandsire's boon, he was free, he forgave those Raksasas that were leading him (to Ravana.)

sa: स लोकानाहिताग्नीनामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्। देवानां च व्यतिक्रम्य ब्रह्मलोकं व्यरोहत॥
en: And proceeding past the regions of highsouled sages sacrificing with fire, as well as of the celestials, he ascended those of Brahmā.

sa: अल्पान्तरगतानां तु श्रुत्वा वचनमङ्गना। आत्मनः प्रतिरूपं सा बभाषे चारुहासिनी॥
en: Hearing those words of the monkeys, lying at a little distance, that lady, smiling sweet, spoke to them, words worthy of herself.

sa: आसीनस्त्वेव भरतः पौरजानपदं जनम्। उवाच सर्वतः प्रेक्ष्य किमार्य नानुशासथ॥
en: Being seated, Bharata, eyeing the citizens and the inhabitants of the provinces, remarked, What for do you not solicit the noble one?

sa: सप्तमी चान्वगात् तासां भगीरथरथं तदा। भगीरथोऽपि राजर्षिदिव्यं स्यन्दनमास्थितः॥ प्रायादग्रे महातेजा गङ्गा तं चाप्यनुव्रजत्। गगनाच्छंकरशिरस्ततो धरणिमागता ॥
en: And the seventh followed Bhagiratha's car. And that royal saint, the exceedingly puissant Bhagiratha, mounted on a superb car, went before; and Gariga followed him. And she descended from the welkin upon Sankara's head, thence alighting upon the earth.

sa: उत्तरीयमिहासक्तं सुव्यक्तं सीतया तदा। तथा ह्येते प्रकाशन्ते सक्ताः कौशेयतन्तवः॥
en: It is clear that Sītā had spread her sheet at this spot, hence it is that fibres of silk are discoverable here.

sa: इत्येतैः कारणैः सौम्य सुग्रीवस्य दुरात्मनः। अहं वानरराजस्य परिभूतः परंतपः॥
en: O subduer of foes, O you of excellent looks, for these reasons, I have been insulted by that vicious-souled king of monkeys-Sugriva.

sa: भरतस्यानृशंसत्वं संचिन्त्याहं पुनः पुनः। नानुशोचामि पितरं मातरं च महाभुज॥
en: Reflecting again and again on Bharata's sincerity of soul, I do not, O mighty-armed one, bewail either my mother or my father.

sa: सुमनोभिश्चितास्तत्र तिलका नक्तमालकाः॥ उत्पलानि च फुल्लानि पङ्कजानि च राघव। न तानि कश्चिन्माल्यानि तत्रारोपयिता नरः॥ न च वै ग्लानतां यान्ति न च शीर्यन्ति राघव। मतङ्गशिष्यास्तत्रासन्नृषयः सुसमाहिताः॥ तेषां भाराभितप्तानां वन्यमाहरतां गुरोः। ये प्रपेतुर्महीं तूर्णं शरीरात् स्वेदबिन्दवः॥ तानि माल्यानि जातानि मुनीनां तपसा तदा। स्वेदबिन्दुसमुत्थानि न विनश्यन्ति राघव ॥
en: There, O Rāghava, the Tilakas and Naktamālakas, crested with flowers and full blown white and red lotuses shall mitigate your sorrows. There live no person who wears garlands of those flowers. Garlands strung with those flowers never wither away, O Rāghava, because the disciples of the great ascetic Matariga lived there with concentrated hearts. Drops of perspiration, falling on the earth from the persons of those ascetics worn out with the burden of the wild fruits collected by them for their spiritual guide, have been transformed by virtue of their asceticism to these garlands. These garlands do never wither, O Rāghava, because of their origination from those drops of perspiration.

sa: कामं खलु दशग्रीवस्तेजोबलसमन्वितः। भवतां तु समर्थानां न किंचिदपि दुष्करम्॥
en: And although the Ten-necked one is endowed with strength and energy, yet to you who are competent, nothing is hard to accomplish.

sa: एतावद् वानरैः शक्यं गन्तुं वानरपुङ्गवाः। अभास्करममर्यादं न जानीमस्ततः परम्॥
en: You foremost of monkey, the monkeys are competent to proceed thus far. Beyond that, of regions sunless and limitless I know nothing.

sa: कथं गङ्गावतरणं कथं तेषां जलक्रिया। तारयेयं कथं चैतानिति चिन्तापरोऽभवत्॥
en: He constantly thought as to how Gangă could be brought down, how to perform their watery rites, and how to deliver them.

sa: पुरा किल महाबाहो तपस्वी सत्यवाञ्छुचिः। कस्मिश्चिंदभवत् पुण्ये वने रतमृगद्विजे॥
en: Formerly, O long-armed one, in a sacred wood haunted by beasts and birds, there lived a truthful ascetic of a pure person.

sa: स भ्रातुः ततस्तं समनुज्ञाप्य गुहमिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः। जगाम तूर्णमव्यग्रः सभार्यः सहलक्ष्मणः॥
en: Then taking the permission of Guha, the descendant of Ikşvāku, holding his soul in calmness, set out with his wife and Lakşmaņa.

sa: विसार्य निपुणां दृष्टिं ततोऽपश्यत् खगाधिपम्। पितृणां मातुलं राम सुपर्णमनिलोपमम्॥
en: And it came to pass, O Rāma, that surveying wide, he descried the maternal uncle to the princes, Suparna, resembling the Wind.

sa: तां तथा रुदतीं रामोऽरुदन् वचनमब्रवीत्॥ जीवन्त्या हि स्त्रिया भर्ता दैवतं प्रभुरेव च। भवत्या मम चैवाद्य राजा प्रभवति प्रभुः॥
en: Rāma, suppressing his feeling, spoke to his mother who was lamenting, thus, saying:, Husband is the deity and master of the wife as long as she lives; so the monarch being the lord can deal with you and me in any way he likes.

sa: ऊनषोडशवर्षों मे रामो राजीवलोचनः। न युद्धयोग्यतामस्य पश्यामि सह राक्षसैः॥
en: My lotus-eyed Ráma is not yet turned of sixteen; and I do not perceive his fitness to cope with Raksasas in battle.

sa: यदि नाहं गमिष्यामि नान्यो वानरपुङ्गवः। पुनः खल्विदमस्माभिः कार्य प्रायोपवेशनम्॥
en: If I go not, nor any other powerful monkey, then we should for certain again sit ourselves down to fast to death.

sa: आत्मानं नियमैस्तैस्तैः कर्षयित्वा प्रयत्नतः। प्राप्यते निपुणैर्धर्मो न सुखाल्लभते सुखम्॥
en: Repressing self by diverse restrictions, intelligent people attain righteousness; but virtue crowned with felicity, is incapable of being attained by following pleasure.

sa: अद्य मे सप्तमी रात्रिश्च्युतस्याकवेश्मनः। अम्बायाः कुशली तातो युधाजिन्मातुलश्च मे॥
en: Seven nights hence I took leave of that revered one's residence. My mother's sire is well, as also my maternal uncle, Yuddhajit.

sa: तं मूर्ध्नि समुपाघ्राय परिष्वज्य यशस्विनम्। अङ्के भरतमारोप्य प्रष्टुं समुपक्रमे॥
en: Then smelling the crown of his head and embracing him and taking that illustrious one on her lap, Kaikeyi addressed him, saying.

sa: वराहरुधिराभेण शुचिना च सुगन्धिना। अनुलिप्तं परायेन चन्दनेन परंतपम्॥ स्थितया पार्श्वतश्चापि वालव्यजनहस्तया। उपेतं सीतया भूयश्चित्रया शशिनं यथा॥
en: Having his body sprinkled with holy and fragrant sandal of the best kind, red as the blood of a hog; and having by him Sītā with a chowry in her hand, like moon himself in the company of citra.

sa: आपृच्छ्य पितरं शूरो रामं चाक्लिष्टकारिणम्॥ मातृश्चापि नरश्रेष्ठः शत्रुघ्नसहितो ययौ।
en: Having greeted his father, and Rāma of unflagging energy, and his mother, that foremost of men, the heroic (Bharata) departed with Satrughna.

sa: स वै दत्तवरः शैलो बभूवावस्थितस्तदा। हनूमांश्च मुहूर्तेन व्यतिचक्राम सागरम्॥
en: Having received boons (from Indra) the Mountain occupied again its pristine place. And Hanumān in a short time crossed over the main.

sa: एवमुक्तोंऽशुमान् सम्यक् सगरेण महात्मना। दनुरादाय खङ्गं च जगाम लघुविक्रमः॥
en: Thus duly enjoined by the high-souled Sagara, Anśumān endowed with fleet vigour, taking his bow as well as his scimitar, set out.

sa: समालभ्य ततः सर्वे कृत्वा चैनं प्रदक्षिणम्। षष्ठिः पुत्रसहस्राणि बिभिदुर्वसुधातलम्॥
en: Having felt as well as gone round him, those sixty thousand sons of Sagara went on penetrating the depths of the earth.

sa: अथ काले गते तस्मिन् विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः॥ सव्रीड इव संवृत्तश्चिन्ताशोकपरायणः।
en: And after this period had gone by, overwhelmed with shame and afflicted with anxiety and grief, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra impatiently thought,

sa: दीक्षितः पौत्रसहितः सोपाध्यायगणस्त्वहम्। इह स्थास्यामि भद्रं वो यावत् तुरगदर्शनम्॥
en: I have been initiated into this sacrifice with my grand-sons and priests.' I will stay here till you light upon the horse.

sa: हृदयेष्ववतिष्ठन्ते वेदा ये नः परं धनम्। वत्स्यन्त्यपि गृहेष्वेव दाराश्चारित्ररक्षिताः॥
en: That best of treasurers, the Vedas, resides in our bosoms; and our wives protected by their chastity shall abide in our homes.

sa: तथोक्ता साप्सरा राम सहस्राक्षेण धीमता। व्रीडिता प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं प्रत्युवाच सुरेश्वरम्॥
en: Thus addressed by the intelligent thousandeyed deity, the Apsarā, O Rāma, with clasped palms, thus bashfully answered the chief of the celestials,

sa: शुश्राव लोकस्य समागतस्य। आत्माधिकारा विविधाश्च वाचः प्रहृष्टरूपस्य पुरे जनस्य॥
en: Rāghava then heard the people coming from different quarters and the well-pleased citizens, talking amongst themselves regarding him in the following strain.

sa: शरत्कालं प्रतीक्षस्व प्रावृटकालोऽयमागतः। ततः सराष्ट्र सगणं रावणं तं वधिष्यसि॥
en: Rains have set in and do you wait for the autumn shall encompass the destruction of Rāvana with his kingdom and kinsmen.

sa: शुशुभे स महातेजा महाकायो महाकपिः। वायुमार्गे निरालम्बे पक्षवानिव पर्वतः॥
en: And that exceedingly energetic highly monkey possessed of a gigantic body, appeared splendid in the unsupported aerial way, like a winged mountain.

sa: प्रणम्य रामस्तान् वृद्धांस्तृतीयायां ददर्श सः। स्त्रियो बालाश्च वृद्धाश्च द्वाररक्षणतत्पराः॥
en: Having bowed down to them, Rāma saw in the third apartment, women, boys, and old men, all engaged in watching the gate.

sa: दिव्यं च मानुषं चैवमात्मनश्च पराक्रमम्। इक्ष्वाकुवृषभावेक्ष्य यतस्व द्विषतां वधे॥
en: O you the best of lkşvākus, do you engage in the destruction of your foes considering well your celestial and human prowess.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा तेजसाऽऽविष्टं प्राव्यथन् वनदेवताः। तस्य रुष्टस्य रूपं तु रामस्य ददृशे तदा। दक्षस्येव क्रतुं हन्तुमुद्यतस्य पिनाकिनः॥
en: And seeing him filled with energy, the sylvan deities were extremely pained*. And the aspect of the enraged Rāma appeared like that of the holder of Pināka, intent upon destroying Dakşa's sacrifice. Another reading is:-The sylvan deities fled away.

sa: अन्ये ऋक्षवतः प्रस्थानुपतस्थुः सहस्रशः॥ अन्ये नानाविधाञ्छैलान् काननानि च भेजिरे।
en: Some of these monkeys began to dwell on the top of the Rkşavān mountain; while others inhabited various other mountains and forests.

sa: पुत्रौ दशरथस्येमौ रामो लक्ष्मण एव च॥ प्रविष्टावाश्रमपदं सीतया सह भार्यया। द्रष्टुं भवन्तमायातौ शुश्रूषार्थमरिंदमौ॥ यदत्रानन्तरं तत् त्वमाज्ञापयितुमर्हसि।
en: For seeing the reverend one, and serving him as well, those subduers of their foes, Dasaratha's sons, Rama and Laksmana, accompanied by Sītā, have entered this asylum. It now behoves you to command what is to be done next.

sa: तानि मुक्तानि शस्त्राणि यातुधानैः स राघवः॥ प्रतिजग्राह विशिखैनद्यौघानिव सागरः।
en: And as the ocean resisted the tide of a river, Rāghava by means of arrow resist the weapons discharged by the Yātudhānas.

sa: इहाश्रमपदोऽस्माकं समीपे शुभदर्शनाः। करिष्ये वोऽत्र पूजां वै सर्वेषां विधिपूर्वकम्॥
en: This auspicious hermitage hard by belongs to us; and there I shall receive you all in due form O' lovely ones! .

sa: एवमुक्तौ तु तौ वीरौ कवन्धेन नरेश्वरौ। गिरिप्रदरमासाद्य पावकं विससर्जतुः॥
en: After Kabandha had spoken thus, the two best of men, Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa took him to a mountain-cave and placed on fire.

sa: अथवा रुचितं स्थानमिह ते रुचिरानने। आविशन्ति च दुर्गाणि क्षिप्रमद्यैव वानराः॥ अभार्याः सहभार्याश्च सन्त्यत्र वनचारिणः। लुब्धेभ्यो विप्रलब्धेभ्यस्तेभ्यो नः सुमहद्भयम्॥
en: O you having a fine countenance, the monkeys shall enter this stronghold, although it is a favourite place with you. Herein dwell many forest-rangers, wifeless and having wives. And we are really afraid of them, avaricious, and formerly deprived of their wealth by us.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा ज्वलितं दीप्त्या तापसं संशितव्रतम्॥ प्रहृष्टवदनो राजा ततोऽर्घ्यमुपहारयत्।
en: And having come to that ascetic observing vows and of flaming energy, the monarch with a cheerful countenance offered him the Arghya.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा सौमित्रिर्विविधान् गुमान्। आजहार ततश्चके पर्णशालामरिंदमः॥
en: Hearing his words, Sumitra's son procured woods of various descriptions, and then that subduer of foes reared a cottage thatched with leaves.

sa: कच्चित् त्वां नावजानन्ति याजकाः पतितं यथा। उग्राप्रतिग्रहीतारं कामयानमिव स्त्रियः॥
en: Do the priests scorn you like a fallen one, even as females do those lascivious folks who use force towards the former?

sa: तस्य धर्मकृतादेशा वयमन्ये च पार्थिवाः। चरामो वसुधां कृत्स्नां धर्मसंतानमिच्छवः॥
en: Ourselves and other kings, being commanded by him to practise piety, have been journeying in this wide world desirous of multiplying virtue.

sa: अपत्यं तु मृगाः सर्वे मृग्या नरवरोत्तम। ऋक्षाश्च मृगमन्दायाः सृमराश्चमरास्तथा॥
en: You foremost of the best of men, Mrgi's sons were all the deer, and those of Mſgamandã were bears, Srmaras and Camaras.

sa: रोहिण्यजनयद् गावो गन्धर्वी वाजिनः सुतान्। सुरसाऽजनयन्त्रागान् राम कद्रूश्च पन्नगान्॥
en: Rohini produced kine, and the sons of Gandharvī are horses. And Surasā, O Rāma, gave birth to Nāgas, and Kadru to Pannagas.

sa: तथाऽऽसनवरं प्राप्य व्यदीपयत राघवः॥ स्वयैव प्रभया मेरुमुदये विमलो रविः।
en: Rāghava shed lustre on that noble seat, as the unclouded sun at his rising lighted up the Sumeru hill with his rays.

sa: ध्यायन्ती तामिवास्वस्थां सीतां चिन्ताहतप्रभाम्॥ उवाच वचनं वीरो रावणो रजनीचरः।
en: Thereat the heroic ranger of the night, Ravana, said to Sita, distressed, sunk in thought, and deprived of her splendour through anxiety,

sa: तस्याः सकाशं दूतोऽहं गमिष्ये रामशासनात्। कर्तुमर्हसि रामस्य साह्यं विषयवासिनि॥
en: At Rāma's command, I go to her as his envoy. It behove you, living in (Rāma's) dominions, to lend him your help.

sa: ततो देवाः पुनरिदमूचुश्चापि हुताशनम्। आविश त्वं महातेजो रौद्रं वायुसमन्वितः॥
en: Then the gods spoke to the Fire, saying, 'Do you in company with the Wind entrain to this fierce an mighty energy!'

sa: एवमुक्ताः सुराः सर्वे प्रत्यूचुर्विष्णुमव्ययम्। मानुषं रूपमास्थाय रावणं जहि संयुगे॥
en: Thus addressed, the deities answered Visnu, incapable of deterioration, saying,-Assuming the form of a human being, do you in battle slay Rāvana!

sa: जनकेन समादिष्टाः सचिवाः प्राविशन् पुरम्। तद्धनुः पुरतः कृत्वा निर्जग्मुरमितौजसः॥
en: Commanded by Janaka, the ministers entered the city; and placing the bow in their front, those, endowed with immeasurable energy, came out.
